Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「盈蓄」强化</>：当前驻场角色获得终结能量时，基于零基础攻击力的50%回复生命。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Restores HP equal to 50% of Zero's Base ATK when the active character gains Ultimate Energy.

ShortDescription.SourceString: <TextHLT>「盈蓄」强化</>：当前驻场角色获得终结能量时，基于零基础攻击力的50%回复生命。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Restores HP equal to 50% of Zero's Base ATK when the active character gains Ultimate Energy.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>这份能够鉴明异象、解读异象的特殊能力，会将命运引往何处？</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Where will this ability to read and understand anomalies lead me?</>

Description.SourceString: 「极轨终结：奇零除尽」造成的伤害提升<NumGreen>25%</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Ultimate: Divide by Zero damage increases by <NumGreen>25%</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 「极轨终结：奇零除尽」造成的伤害提升<NumGreen>25%</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Increases damage dealt by <NumGreen>25%</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>第零感——同调。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Zeroth Sense Synchronization</>

Description.SourceString: 薄荷挥动她的武器，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Wields her weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 薄荷在空中挥动武器，并迅速下落冲击地面，落地时造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Wields her weapon in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：满分收容术」触发。薄荷轻松跃起躲过攻击后抓住敌人的破绽，迅速挥动武器，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Perfect Containment after a Critical Dodge. Leaps up to dodge an attack, seizes the enemy's opening, and swiftly swings her weapon, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 长按「普通攻击」，薄荷舞动身体，旋转自身形成龙卷风，持续消耗耐力并对周围的敌人造成持续范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack to make Mint dance and spin, forming a tornado that continuously drains Stamina and deals continuous <Ling>Anima DMG</> to surrounding enemies.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 长按「普通攻击」，持续造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>4秒。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack to continuously deal <Ling>Anima DMG</> for 4s.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「本次收容实操模拟考核第一名，收容二组，薄荷。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"First place in the Containment Simulation Exam: Mint, from CSU-2."</>

Desc.SourceString: 长按普攻每秒体力消耗

Description.SourceString: 来降降温！薄荷向前突进后回到原处，并对路径上的敌人造成<NumGreen>2</>次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Time to cool things down! Dashes forward, then returns to her original position, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of AoE <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemies along the path.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「冰淇淋是凉的，薄荷也是凉的，那碎雪的薄荷冰淇淋就是双份的快乐！呜……光是想想都已经凉得发抖了！」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Ice cream is cool, mint is cool, so mint ice cream from Blizzi means double the happiness! Ooha… I'm already shivering just thinking about it!"</>

Description.SourceString: 准备好了吗！薄荷牵引身边的风汇聚于双刀上，化身风刃，造成多段范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，落地的最后一击造成高额的范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Are you ready! Channels the surrounding wind into her dual blades, transforming them into wind blades that deal multiple instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area. Lands with a final hit that deals massive <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>全称是「终极薄荷奥义之霹雳无敌托马斯回旋疾风斩」，当然这个名字受到了来自前辈们的狠狠嘲笑，最终变成了现在的简化版。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>The full name is "Mint's Ultimate: Super Duper Ultra 360 Whirlwind Slash", but I had to shorten it to what it is now because people wouldn't stop laughing about it.</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「创生」强化</>：「创生花」命中时伤害范围扩大。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Expands Vita Pistils' damage area on hit.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「看好了，我已经不是以前的薄荷了！现在你面前的可是异象管理局超级精英员工！」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Watch closely now! I'm not the same as before! You're now face-to-face with an elite operative!"</>

Description.SourceString: 薄荷在前台时，自身防御力提升<NumGreen>20%</>，抗打断能力提升<NumGreen>30%</>。
Description.LocalizedString: While Mint is on the field, her DEF is increased by <NumGreen>20%</> and her resistance to Interruptions is increased by <NumGreen>30%</>.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>临近收工时总会获得额外动力加成，如果再加上店铺上新……</>
<Italic>「完蛋完蛋，还有五分钟就要关门了！乖乖站成一排被泯除吧！」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>There's always that extra burst of energy when work's almost done, especially when putting out new arrivals…</>
<Italic>"Five minutes till close! Line up nicely and get nullified!"</>

Description.SourceString: 长按「普通攻击」，薄荷舞动身体，旋转自身形成龙卷风，持续消耗耐力并对周围的敌人造成持续范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack to make Mint dance and spin, forming a tornado that continuously drains Stamina and deals continuous <Ling>Anima DMG</> to surrounding enemies.

Description.SourceString: 早雾挥动鬼郎丸，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Sakiri swings Kiroumaru and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
长按使鬼郎丸进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">「摄食模式」</>，早雾跃起坐到鬼郎丸上，期间可移动。
饥饿状态时，鬼郎丸张口持续吸引扇形范围内的目标，可移动类场景道具会被鬼郎丸吸至身前并破坏，弱小的敌人会被吸至身前并吞噬。
每吞噬<NumGreen>1</>个敌人，需要对其进行持续<NumGreen>180</>秒的消化。最多可同时消化<NumGreen>1</>个目标。
当肚子里正在消化的目标数量达到上限时，鬼郎丸进入饱食状态，此状态下可移动，无法继续吸引和吞噬。
松开长按解除该模式。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hold to activate <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</> with Kiroumaru. Mounts Sakiri onto Kiroumaru, allowing movement.
Opens its mouth to continuously pull nearby targets within a cone while Hungry. Destroys movable objects in the scene and devours weak enemies.
Takes <NumGreen>180s</> to digest <NumGreen>each</> devoured enemy, with only <NumGreen>1</> target digested at a time.
Becomes Full when the number of enemies being digested reaches the limit, remaining movable but unable to pull or devour enemies.
Release to exit the mode.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 长按使鬼郎丸进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">「摄食模式」</>，早雾跃起坐到鬼郎丸上，期间可移动。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold to activate <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</> with Kiroumaru. Mounts Sakiri onto Kiroumaru, allowing movement.

Description.SourceString: 早雾在空中挥动鬼郎丸，并迅速下落冲击地面，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Wields Kiroumaru in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：猛撞」触发。早雾高高跃起，用起鬼郎丸狠狠砸向因为失手而露出破绽的敌人，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Ram after a Critical Dodge. Leaps high into the air and strikes down hard with Kiroumaru against enemies left vulnerable by their missed attacks. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area and reduces Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>据某位曾经历了被鬼郎丸吞下肚，绝望了很久之后才被早雾掏出来的、不愿意透露姓名的塔姓歧骸表示——在鬼郎丸的肚子里，运气好还能捡到没消化完的游戏机，打打游戏消磨时间等待救援……倒也还不错？</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>According to Mr. T, an oddity who survived the depths of Kiroumaru's belly and lived to tell the tale thanks to Sakiri's timely intervention, hints at an unexpected perk: Amidst the gloom, one might unearth a half-digested game console to while away the hours—a quirky, entertaining twist to an otherwise harrowing wait for rescue.</>

Description.SourceString: 点按发动。鬼郎丸张开大口，吸附附近范围内的敌人，然后膨胀起来并将敌人撞倒。
Description.LocalizedString: Press to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then inflates and knocks down the enemy.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 吸附附近范围的敌人，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Pulls nearby enemies, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 长按发动。鬼郎丸张开大口，吸附附近范围内的敌人，然后一口咬穿地面。咬穿位置的重力被吞噬，位于此处的敌人会悬浮到空中（对强大的敌人不生效）。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then bites through the ground, devouring the gravity in that area, levitating enemies there (not effective against powerful enemies).

ShortDescription.SourceString: 吸附并浮空附近范围的敌人，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Pulls and levitates nearby enemies, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「找、找雾，桌个……唔、可以吃莫？」「蠢货，不应该在吞下去之后才问吧！」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Sa… Sakiri, can I eat this?" "Moron, next time ask before you eat!"</>

Description.SourceString: 这下跑不掉了吧？鬼郎丸自上空吐出大量的重力沼液，造成<NumGreen>6</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。命中的敌人会受到强劲的重力影响，被重重压向地面（对boss不生效）。被<TextHLT>压制</>的敌人一段时间内无法移动。释放「极轨终结：千钧隆重的饕餮宴」后，基于早雾基础攻击力提升全队角色（不包括早雾）的攻击力。
Description.LocalizedString: No escaping this time! Kiroumaru spits out a large amount of Gravity Slurry from above, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area. Applies strong gravity to hit enemies, pressing them heavily to the ground (not effective against Bosses). Prevents <TextHLT>Suppressed</> enemies from moving for a period. Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) based on Sakiri's Base ATK.

ShortDescription.SourceString: <TextHLT>压制</>敌人，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。释放后基于早雾攻击力提升全队（不包括早雾）攻击力。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Suppresses</> enemies, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) based on her ATK.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>在大块朵颐到心满意足之前，不可能会允许餐点们自己长腿跑掉的。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>No prey escapes before Kiroumaru has its fill.</>

Description.SourceString: 看看哪个倒霉蛋要被砸扁了？早雾将膨大化的鬼郎丸重重砸向目标，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Let's see which unlucky soul is about to get squashed? Sakiri slams the enlarged Kiroumaru heavily onto the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「鬼郎丸你给我停下！嗯？刚刚是不是撞到了什么东西？」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Kiroumaru, stop right there! Hm? Did you just bump into something?</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「浊燃」强化</>：「浊燃」状态下，目标身上每有一种持续伤害状态，受到的持续伤害提升25%，上限提升100%。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Increases DoT taken by the target by 25% for each type of DoT effect while in Scorch state, up to 100%.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>还没到能开动的时候呢！比起囫囵一口吞……再多加点料不是更好吗？不闹得更大一点就没劲了！</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>It's not time to start yet! Instead of swallowing whole… wouldn't it be better to add more ingredients? Can't let the fun pass!</>

Description.SourceString: 早雾成功对敌人施加「浮空」或「<TextHLT>压制</>」后，使敌人防御力下降10%，持续20秒。
Description.LocalizedString: Reduces enemies' DEF by 10% for 20s after inflicting Airborne or <TextHLT>Suppress</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>不听话的孩子……是要被鬼上身的……？嗯，也可能是上口？</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Those on the naughty list… will be taken by ghosts… or perhaps eaten?</>

Description.SourceString:
安魂曲挥舞「平底锅」，发动至多5段连续攻击，造成<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
第2段攻击产生的子弹可被后续攻击击破，引发爆炸，并造成额外<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Swings her Frying Pan, performing up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
The projectile generated by the 2nd attack can be shattered by subsequent attacks, causing an explosion and dealing extra <An>Chaos DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 安魂曲操纵「猩红果冻」，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Manipulates Red Jelly, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
可随时通过瞄准键使用「风味变奏」。
当安魂曲当前使用「普通攻击：茄汁金属乐」时，安魂曲甩出「平底锅」并向前飞踢，对命中的目标各造成1次<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，随后攻击模组将替换为「普通攻击：茄汁打击乐」。
当安魂曲当前使用「普通攻击：茄汁打击乐」时，安魂曲跃起后重击地面，造成1次范围<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，随后攻击模组将替换为「普通攻击：茄汁金属乐」。
普通攻击风格的不同将决定「极轨终结：工作日最终审判」的攻击方式。
Description.LocalizedString:
Flavor Variation can be used at any time via the Aim button.
Tosses her Frying Pan and performs a flying kick forward when using Tomato Metal, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to each target hit. Switches her attack module to Tomato Percussion.
Leaps into the air and slams the ground, dealing 1 instance of AoE <An>Chaos DMG</> when using Tomato Percussion. Switches her attack module to Tomato Metal.
The current Basic Attack style determines the attack pattern of Working Day Judgement.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 瞄准键切换攻击风格，造成<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Press Aim to switch attack style, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
长按使安魂曲进入瞄准状态，对准心范围内的敌人造成1次单体的<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，并习得该敌人的战斗技巧。
学习成功后，安魂曲将暂时遗忘「变轨技能：起床气加载中」，并使用习得的战斗技巧。
习得的战斗技巧将长期保存于安魂曲的记忆中。可以习得新技巧以替换原有技巧，或在技能页面使安魂曲主动遗忘该技巧，从而重新回忆起「变轨技能：起床气加载中」。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hold to enter Aim mode. Deals 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an enemy in the crosshair and learns their combat technique.
Temporarily forgets Morning Tomato and uses the learned technique upon successful learning.
Learned techniques are stored permanently in Lacrimosa's memory. New techniques can be learned to replace existing ones, or Lacrimosa can actively forget a technique on the Skill page to recall Morning Tomato.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 长按进入瞄准，造成<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，并习得其技能。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold to enter Aim mode. Deals <An>Chaos DMG</> and learns the enemy's skill.

UnlockDesc.SourceString: <Red>完成番外《番茄酱暴走现场实录！》后解锁</>
UnlockDesc.LocalizedString: <Red>Unlocks after completing Spinoff "Tomato Jelly Rampage: Live Report!"</>

Description.SourceString: 安魂曲在空中操纵异能造物，并迅速下落冲击地面，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Manipulates Esper Ability Constructs in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击」触发。安魂曲抓住敌人攻击落空的破绽，将大量「猩红果冻」猛地砸向敌人头顶，造成<NumGreen>6</>次范围性的<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Basic Attacks after a Critical Dodge. Seizes the opening created by the enemy's missed attack and violently hurls a large amount of Red Jelly onto the enemy's head, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
安魂曲攻击命中时，为目标施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">「噩梦」</>状态，至多可叠加10层。
如果1次「普通攻击」造成了多段伤害，每段伤害命中时都将附加1层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">「噩梦」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on the target when attacks hit, up to 10 stacks.
Inflicts 1 stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> per damage instance when a single Basic Attack deals multiple instances of damage.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 攻击命中施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">「噩梦」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Attacks inflict <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on hit.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>世上本没有路，安魂曲创造的大小车辆、长短路牌多了，也就成了路。唯一的问题是——路牌太多，在规则上容易自相矛盾。要怎么样才能同时左转和右转呢？</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>At first, there were no roads. Then Lacrimosa made lots of vehicles and road signs, and suddenly roads appeared. The problem? Too many signs with contradictory rules. How are you supposed to turn left and right at the same time?</>

Desc.SourceString: 近战普攻一段伤害倍率
近战普攻二段伤害倍率
近战普攻三段伤害倍率
近战普攻四段伤害倍率
近战普攻五段伤害倍率
远程普攻一段伤害倍率
远程普攻二段伤害倍率
远程普攻三段伤害倍率
远程普攻四段伤害倍率
远程普攻五段伤害倍率

Description.SourceString:
阿……阿嚏！安魂曲失手掷出大量未成型的异能造物，对范围内全体目标造成<NumGreen>1</>次<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，并为目标附加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">「噩梦」</>状态。
释放「变轨技能：起床气加载中」后，可直接释放「普通攻击：茄汁金属乐」或「普通攻击：茄汁打击乐」的第<NumGreen>5</>段。
Description.LocalizedString:
Ah… Achoo! Throws a barrage of unfinished Esper Ability Constructs, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to all targets within the area and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on the targets.
Combos into the <NumGreen>5</>th instance of Tomato Metal or Tomato Percussion after casting Morning Tomato.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成范围<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">「噩梦」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</>.

Description.SourceString:
安魂曲……也能做到。安魂曲使用异能，创造出与技巧原主相同的怪物并发动攻击，同时触发相应的技巧附加效果。技巧的释放时长与技巧原主相同。在释放期间，安魂曲无法移动，但可以主动取消释放或切换其他角色入场战斗。若在释放技巧期间安魂曲遭到攻击，则会受到伤害。
释放「变轨技能：恶魔的礼物」时，安魂曲自动获得相当于技巧原主一定百分比的攻击力。
Description.LocalizedString:
Creates mobs identical to those of the original skill owner using Lacrimosa's Esper Ability and initiates an attack, simultaneously triggering the corresponding skill's additional effects. Matches the skill duration of the original skill owner. Prevents Lacrimosa from moving during the cast but allows her to actively cancel the cast or switch to other characters. Causes Lacrimosa to take damage if she is attacked during the cast.
Grants Lacrimosa a percentage of the original skill owner's ATK upon casting Devilish Gift.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 释放习得的技能。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Casts the acquired skill.

UnlockDesc.SourceString: <Red>完成番外《番茄酱暴走现场实录！》后解锁</>
UnlockDesc.LocalizedString: <Red>Unlocks after completing Spinoff "Tomato Jelly Rampage: Live Report!"</>

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>「……啊。安魂曲，不是故意……」</>
<Italic>「哈哈，小弥撒刚刚干得漂亮！回去让翳给你买冰淇淋！」</>
<Italic>「……白藏，多嘴。冰淇淋，要三个球……」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>"Ah. Lacrimosa… didn't mean to…"</>
<Italic>"Haha, nice work there, Mosa! Let's have Skia buy you some ice cream!"</>
<Italic>"Baicang, nosy. Ice cream… three scoops…"</>

Desc.SourceString: 「恶魔的礼物」获得原主攻击力
「恶魔的礼物」最高获得攻击力
「恶魔的礼物」最低获得攻击力
「恶魔的礼物」攻击力持续时间

Description.SourceString:
当安魂曲当前使用「普通攻击：茄汁金属乐」时，安魂曲操控「货车」，造成10段范围性的<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，并为范围内的所有目标附加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">「噩梦」</>。

当安魂曲当前使用「普通攻击：茄汁打击乐」时，安魂曲拆解「汽车」，造成5段范围性的<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，并为范围内的所有目标附加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">「噩梦」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Controls the Truck when using Tomato Metal, dealing 10 instances of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on all targets in range.

Dismantles the Car when using Tomato Percussion, dealing 5 instances of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on all targets in range.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成范围<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">「噩梦」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>异象管理局专业维修员布洛凯德温馨提示：本月E.T.D四队免费报修额度已用尽，费用将从报修人绩效中相应扣除。请部分队员（重音）爱护管理局公物，尤其爱护未经强化的玻璃制品和精密电子设备。部分队员（重音）如需拿取自动贩卖机内的商品，请求助你的队长或副队长。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>A friendly reminder from Barracuda, BAC's Professional Maintenance Staff: ETD-4 has exhausted their free maintenance quota for this month. Future repair costs will be deducted from the performance bonus of those who file the requests. CERTAIN team members are kindly reminded to take better care of Bureau property, especially non-reinforced glass items and sensitive electronic equipment. CERTAIN team members needing items from the vending machine should seek assistance from their squad captain or lieutenant.</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「失谐」强化</>：触发「失谐」时，若目标已处于倾陷状态，则对目标额外造成400%攻击力的伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Discord Enhancement</>: Deals additional DMG equal to 400% of ATK to the target when Discord is triggered, if the target is already Broken.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>工作日清早的闹钟，拥有混淆人类记忆的魔法。</>
<Italic>「……所以，这就是你迟到的理由？」</>
<Italic>「……第一个、第二个闹钟，安魂曲都按掉了。但是，全都不记得……」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>Weekday morning alarms… magic, mess with memory.</>
<Italic>"So this is your excuse for being late?"</>
<Italic>"Alarm 1, Alarm 2, Lacrimosa turned them all off. But… ah… Lacrimosa can't remember…"</>

Description.SourceString: 技能冷却期间，安魂曲使用「普通攻击：茄汁金属乐」或「普通攻击：茄汁打击乐」<NumGreen>5</>次后，额外获得<NumGreen>1</>次「变轨技能：起床气加载中」使用次数。此效果在每次技能冷却期间仅生效<NumGreen>1</>次。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants <NumGreen>1</> additional attempt of Morning Tomato after Lacrimosa uses Tomato Metal or Tomato Percussion <NumGreen>5</> times during the skill cooldown. Activates only <NumGreen>1</> time per skill cooldown.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>有时候，一个人的美梦也会成为另一个人的噩梦。所以说，为什么人不会被自己的梦呓吵醒呢？</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>One person's sweet dream can be another's nightmare. Makes you wonder… why don't people wake themselves up with their sleep talking?</>

Description.SourceString: 安魂曲在梦中化身蝙蝠，自由飞翔。在非战斗状态下，长按闪避可触发飞行模式，飞行期间会消耗耐力。
Description.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa transforms into a bat in her dream, flying freely. When out of combat, hold dodge to enter flight. Flight costs stamina.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「安魂曲，可以飞。但是，玻璃，总是撞到，讨厌。还有，安魂曲睡着了，就会摔下来……」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Lacrimosa can fly. But glass… always hit it. Hate it. And when Lacrimosa sleeps… down from the sky!"</>

Description.SourceString: 解决这个，就可以休息了。安魂曲迅速操纵异能造物，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa get this done, and Lacrimosa get to sleep… Manipulates Esper Ability Constructs, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成范围<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>安魂曲不在乎反派们的悲惨身世，她只想早点下班回家睡觉。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Lacrimosa couldn't care less about villain arcs and tragic backstories. She just wants to clock out and go home to sleep.</>

Description.SourceString: 法帝娅挥动化形的十字盾，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Swings her cross shield and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
当法帝娅当前生命值大于<NumGreen>1</>点时，能利用异能替队友分摊护盾抵挡前的伤害，已被分摊的伤害无法再次被分摊。
当法帝娅当前生命值等于<NumGreen>1</>点时，不再替队友分摊伤害。此时，若法帝娅受到伤害，优先将护盾抵挡之前的伤害与存活的队友进行分摊，分摊后的伤害自行承受。
Description.LocalizedString:
When Fadia's current HP is greater than <NumGreen>1</>, she redirects a portion of damage taken by her teammates to herself before any shield mitigation is applied. Redirected damage cannot be further redistributed.
Once Fadia's current HP drops to <NumGreen>1</>, she ceases to redirect damage. At this point, if Fadia receives damage, she will share it with surviving teammates before any shield mitigation, and will absorb the remaining damage herself.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 法帝娅生命值大于1点时，能替队友分摊伤害；法帝娅生命值等于1点时，会把受到的伤害与存活的队友进行分摊。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Shares damage with allies while Fadia's HP is above 1. Distributes incoming damage among surviving allies when Fadia's HP equals 1.

Description.SourceString: 法帝娅在空中挥动化形十字盾下砸，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Swings her cross shield in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：话语中断的否定」触发。法帝娅高速冲撞向目标并造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when casting Wordless Rejection after a Critical Dodge. Charges toward the target at high speed and deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area, reducing Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>活着最为可笑的，就是屈从于意义的不言自明，屈从于命令的力量——所以，看着你们这些可怜虫，为什么不笑呢？</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>The most laughable thing about being alive is how you bow to self-evident meanings and submit to the power of orders. So why not laugh at you pitiful worms?</>

Description.SourceString:
不如，让你们也体验一下吧~法帝娅对范围内全体目标造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，并对范围内生命上限最高的敌方单位施加一段时间的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">「破灭体验」</>。
持续时间内，当法帝娅自身受到伤害时，目标将会以一定比例共享法帝娅所受伤害量。
持续时间结束，目标通过<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">「破灭体验」</>受到的共享伤害达到最大值或目标和法帝娅脱离战斗状态时均会移除<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">「破灭体验」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Come, have a taste of this. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> on the enemy with the highest Max HP in the area for a period.
During the duration, when Fadia takes damage, the target shares a percentage of the damage taken.
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> ends when the duration expires, when the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Redirection DMG</> taken by the target reaches its cap, or when the target and Fadia leave combat.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，并对生命上限最高的敌方单位施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">「破灭体验」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> on the enemy with the highest Max HP.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「那个——打断一下，一点来自她队友的友善提示，这种时候还没头没脑地攻击她，可不是一个好选择哦……」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Oh hey—just a friendly tip from her teammate: attacking her right now might not be the smartest move…"</>

Description.SourceString:
倘若没有痛苦，生命就将封闭于自身。法帝娅进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">「敌神者」</>状态，并造成<NumGreen>6</>段心灵伤害，同时回复生命值。在<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">「敌神者」</>状态下，再次释放「普通攻击：话语中断的否定」可进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段追击，每次追击造成心灵伤害。
当已损失生命值到达<TextHLT>「破灭阈值」</>时，立刻使「极轨终结：痛苦让位于狂喜」恢复满能量；在已损失生命值大于等于<TextHLT>「破灭阈值」</>时释放「极轨终结：痛苦让位于狂喜」，「极轨终结：痛苦让位于狂喜」造成的伤害提升，回复生命值提升。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">「敌神者」</>持续时间结束、5段追击释放完毕、切换角色或使用法帝娅其他技能均会使法帝娅退出<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">「敌神者」</>状态。
Description.LocalizedString:
Without pain, life closes in on itself. Enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of Mental DMG and restoring HP. Recasts Wordless Rejection while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state to perform up to <NumGreen>5</> follow-up attacks, each dealing Mental DMG.
Fully restores the energy of Agony to Euphoria when lost HP reaches the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>. Increases the damage and HP restored by Agony to Euphoria when it is cast with lost HP greater than or equal to the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>.
Exits <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state when the duration ends, all 5 follow-up attacks are performed, characters are switched, or other skills of Fadia are used.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
法帝娅进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">「敌神者」</>状态，并造成6段心灵伤害，同时回复生命值。<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">「敌神者」</>状态下可以释放5段追击造成心灵伤害。
当已损失生命值到达<TextHLT>「破灭阈值」</>时，立刻使极轨终结恢复满能量；在已损失生命值大于等于<TextHLT>「破灭阈值」</>时释放极轨终结，极轨终结造成的伤害提升，回复生命值提升。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state, dealing 6 instances of Mental DMG and restoring HP. Performs up to 5 follow-up attacks while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state, each dealing Mental DMG.
Fully restores the Ultimate's energy when lost HP reaches the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>. Increases the damage and HP restored when casting the Ultimate with lost HP greater than or equal to the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「既然局长选择对『不稳定』加以利用，那我的职责则是观察与制约，力保这种危险的『不稳定』处在可控范围内。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Since the Director chose to exploit this instability, my duty is to observe and restrict it—to ensure such dangerous volatility stays within controllable bounds."</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「黯星」强化</>：「黯星」状态结束时，全队角色从目标汲取生命上限。目标损失相当于法帝娅固有生命上限200%的生命上限，全队角色各获得法帝娅10%固有生命上限，累计汲取不超过法帝娅固有生命上限的50%。离开战斗状态时还原双方属性。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Allows all allies to drain Max HP from the target when Nova ends. The target loses Max HP equal to 200% of Fadia's base Max HP, and each ally gains Max HP equal to 10% of Fadia's base Max HP. Total drained cannot exceed 50% of Fadia's base Max HP. Restores both parties' stats upon exiting combat.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>更多……更多！填满这种空洞——如果你能做到！</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>More… MORE! Fill this void—if you can!</>

Description.SourceString: 如婴儿渴求母亲的奶水一般。法帝娅在队伍中时，全队获得<NumGreen>10%</>最大生命值提升。
Description.LocalizedString: Like a baby yearning for nourishment from mommy. When Fadia is in the team, increases team max HP by <NumGreen>10%</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>想要的东西，夺过来就好了。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>If you want it, go grab it.</>

Description.SourceString: 法帝娅在都市中会遇到对其有好感的店员，与这些店员对话后可获得特殊赠礼。
Description.LocalizedString: Allows Fadia to receive special gifts from shopkeepers who take a liking to her while exploring the city.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>一次任务返途跟翳路过玉饼商店街，安魂曲走进2-four便利店，以为自己会像法帝娅每次被塞礼物那样抱着一堆沉甸甸的免费番茄酱走出……</>
<Italic>最终打开空空的臂弯接过了翳现买的任务奖励。</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>When Skia and Lacrimosa passed by Tamamochi Street after a mission, Lacrimosa went into a 2-Four Convenience Store. She thought she'd walk out with arms full of free tomato jelly packets, just like how Fadia always gets showered with gifts…</>
<Italic>In the end, all she got was a reward that Skia bought right there and then.</>

Description.SourceString: 法帝娅挥动化形十字盾，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Swings her cross shield, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area.

Description.SourceString: 娜娜莉张牙舞爪，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。连段过程中使用闪避不会中断当前连段。
Description.LocalizedString: Bares her fangs and brandishes her claws, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Dodging does not interrupt the combo.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。

ShortDescription.LocalizedString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。

Description.LocalizedString: Enters aim mode, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of single-target <Ling>Anima DMG</> to the enemy in the crosshair.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。

Description.SourceString: 娜娜莉在空中挥出爪子，并迅速下落冲击地面，落地时造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。

ShortDescription.SourceString: 长按普攻，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。

ShortDescription.LocalizedString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。

Description.SourceString: <Italic>据说是来自「柯林斯家族」秘不外传的战斗技法，显然招式之间融合了很多海特洛市的街头特色。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Said to be a secret combat technique passed down in the Coluccis, though it clearly incorporates many street-fighting elements from Hethereau.</>

Description.SourceString:
哼哼，来点惊喜！娜娜莉立即对周围敌人造成<NumGreen>5</>次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并使用灵系异能包裹全身，进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">「一代目的权柄」</>状态。

在<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">「一代目的权柄」</>持续期间再次释放将退出该状态。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hehe, surprise time! Deals <NumGreen>5</> instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to surrounding enemies and wraps herself in Anima Esper Ability, gaining the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> effect.
Lasts <NumGreen>12s</> or until Nanally is switched out.
Ends <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> early when recast.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">「一代目的权柄」</>状态。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">「一代目的权柄」</>状态。

Description.SourceString: <Italic>薄荷试图向娜娜莉学习这招，但看到静电后的毛发弯曲毛糙分叉打结，瞬间放弃了这个想法，毕竟异象管理局里可没有精通毛发护理的阿德勒先生。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Mint tried to learn this move from Nanally, but the moment she saw that Nanally's hair went rough, curved, split, and knotted, she gave up the idea. Adler is not with her in the Bureau of Anomaly Control to take care of her hair, after all.</>

Description.SourceString:
绝、绝对不是打不过！娜娜莉立刻对周围敌人造成<NumGreen>7</>次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并召唤「副手」一同战斗。
「副手」在场时，娜娜莉的攻击将会对周围敌人造成小范围的牵引效果，且「副手」会配合娜娜莉的所有攻击发起攻势，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，该伤害同时被视为<TextHLT>追加攻击</>伤害。
Description.LocalizedString:
I'm way stronger than them! Deals <NumGreen>7</> instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> immediately to surrounding enemies and summons Underboss to fight alongside her.
Creates a small pull effect on surrounding enemies with Nanally's attacks while Underboss is active, and coordinates with all of Nanally's attacks to launch strikes, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> that also counts as <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> damage.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并召唤「副手」一同战斗。「副手」造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并视为<TextHLT>追加攻击</>。

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>「好不容易才来了个昏头昏脑的，看上件店里的东西想买，要不是浔死不松口，哼……这个月销售额也不会是零蛋了。」</>
<Italic>「臭小鬼，没看他砍的那个价吗？这是把咱们伊波恩当叫花子打发呢，我没喊小水仙去削他都不错了！」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>"Finally, someone clueless comes along who actually wants to buy something from the shop, but if it wasn't for Hotori refusing to budge, hmph… this month's sales wouldn't be a big fat zero."</>
<Italic>"That little brat, didn't you see what kind of price he was trying to haggle? He's treating our Eibon like we're some charity case! I was being nice not calling Daff over to rough him up!"</>

Description.SourceString:
「变轨技能：今景复映」无需冷却时间。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">「非闭合时计」</>积蓄的能量大于<NumGreen>60</>时，浔可以消耗<NumGreen>60</>能量释放「变轨技能：今景复映」造成<NumGreen>7</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，同时开始鉴赏并记录队友接下来<NumGreen>5</>秒内发动的「援护技」和「变轨技能」。「变轨技能：今景复映」一次最多记录<NumGreen>3</>个「援护技」或「变轨技能」的发动时机，每个角色最多被记录一次。
使用期间将持续回拨指针，回拨一定刻度后停止记录，如提前完成记录，指针将继续回拨固定刻度。进入战斗或离开战斗时，会清除已记录的内容。已有记录时再次使用「变轨技能：今景复映」，将覆盖原有记录。
Description.LocalizedString:
Requires no cooldown for Present Replay.
Allows Hotori to spend <NumGreen>60</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> energy to cast Present Replay when energy is greater than <NumGreen>60</>. Deals <NumGreen>7</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area. Records Support Skills and Redirect Skills used by allies for the next <NumGreen>5</>s, appreciating up to <NumGreen>3</> timings per use, with each character recorded at most once.
Rewinds the Non-Closed Timepiece pointer continuously during use. Stops recording after the pointer rewinds a certain amount, and continues rewinding a fixed amount if recording completes early. Clears records when entering or leaving battle. Overwrites existing records when using Present Replay again.

ShortDescription.SourceString: <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">「非闭合时计」</>积蓄的能量大于<NumGreen>60</>时，释放「变轨技能：今景复映」造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，同时开始记录队友接下来<NumGreen>5</>秒内发动的「援护技」和「变轨技能」。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Casts Present Replay when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> energy is greater than <NumGreen>60</>, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and recording Support Skills and Redirect Skills used by allies for the next <NumGreen>5s</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>注视、见证。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Observe and Witness</>

Description.SourceString:
「极轨终结：浮世来潮」无需冷却时间和终结能量。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">「非闭合时计」</>的能量蓄满时，浔可以释放「极轨终结：浮世来潮」造成<NumGreen>10</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，同时从伞柄中拔出太刀，攻击模式将会改变。随后，使周遭时间趋于停止，期间不能切换角色。进入时停会清除受到的时间控制类负面效果，时停期间免疫时间控制类负面效果。如果有「变轨技能：今景复映」记录的攻击，会复现<NumGreen>1</>次记录的所有攻击，并清除记录。
时停期间，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">「非闭合时计」</>的指针将持续回拨。此外，浔的太刀攻击会积累段势，每段攻击伤害递增，段势积累到<NumGreen>10</>段时造成终结伤害。指针回拨到底或造成终结伤害都会结束时停。
Description.LocalizedString:
Has no cooldown or Ultimate Energy cost for World's Tide.
Allows Hotori to unleash World's Tide when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> energy is fully charged, dealing <NumGreen>10</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area. Draws a katana from the umbrella handle and changes attack mode. Slows surrounding time to near standstill for a period, disabling character switching. Cleanses any received time control debuffs and grants immunity to time control debuffs during Time Stop. Replays all attacks recorded by Present Replay <NumGreen>1</> time and clears the records if any exist.
Rewinds the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> pointer continuously during Time Stop. Builds combo stacks with Hotori's katana attacks, increasing damage per hit. Deals Finisher DMG when combo stacks reach <NumGreen>10</>. Ends time stop when the pointer rewinds completely or when Finisher DMG is dealt.

ShortDescription.SourceString: <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">「非闭合时计」</>的能量蓄满时，释放「极轨终结：浮世来潮」造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，同时拔出太刀，并使周遭的时间趋于停止。太刀攻击会积累段势，累积<NumGreen>10</>段时可触发终结时停的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Casts World's Tide when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> energy is fully charged, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>, drawing the katana, and slowing surrounding time to near standstill. Builds combo stacks with katana attacks, and triggers <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to end Time Stop when reaching <NumGreen>10</> stacks.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>然后——前往既定的未来。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Then—proceed toward the predetermined future.</>

ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>对于浔来说仅仅是小露一下身手，而跳脚说要投诉的难缠客人们将能了解到这区区一家破店也敢提出「霸王条款」的底气。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>For Hotori, this is merely a small display of her abilities, but difficult customers who threaten to complain will learn exactly why this humble little shop dares to impose such strict terms.</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「创生」强化</>：时停期间，「创生株」攻击不暂停。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Prevents Vita Bud attacks from pausing during Time Stop.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>至少在这位总是能为了几个子儿絮絮叨叨个不停的老板娘终于安静下来，静坐着品酒赏月时，还是能发觉……她气质不俗。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>At least when this proprietress, who can usually chatter on endlessly about every penny, finally quiets down and sits peacefully sipping wine while admiring the moon, you can still notice… she is an elegant and graceful person.</>

Description.SourceString: 「极轨终结：浮世来潮」的终结伤害倍率提升<NumGreen>100%</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Increases World's Tide's Finisher DMG Ratio by <NumGreen>100%</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「干杯！庆祝！再……再庆祝一次！宝、宝贝……宝贝……全是我的了！成交……成交！呵呵呵呵……嗝……给我……统统守好咯……zzZ……」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Cheers! Celebrate! Let's… let's celebrate again! My treasures… my precious treasures… they're all mine now! Deal… deal! Hehehe… hic… guard them all… for me… zzZ…</>

Description.SourceString:
雪，落得再慢些吧。浔在战斗外，当<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">「非闭合时计」</>积蓄的能量大于<NumGreen>0</>时，直接长按普通攻击可减缓时间流速，使周遭的时间趋于停止。进入时停会清除受到的时间控制类负面效果，时停期间免疫时间控制类负面效果。
时停期间，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">「非闭合时计」</>的指针将持续回拨，浔不可使用其他影响时间的技能。指针回拨到底、浔长按普通攻击、进入战斗、切换场景等行为都会结束时停。
Description.LocalizedString:
Let the snow fall slower still. Activates time manipulation when Hotori is outside of battle and the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> has accumulated energy greater than <NumGreen>0</>. Slows the flow of time while holding Basic Attack, causing the surrounding time to approach a standstill. Removes any received time control debuffs and grants immunity to time control debuffs during Time Stop.
Rewinds the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> pointer continuously during Time Stop. Prevents Hotori from using other time-affecting skills. Ends Time Stop when the pointer fully rewinds, holding Basic Attack, entering battle, switching scenes, or performing other actions.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 浔在战斗外，当<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">「非闭合时计」</>积蓄的能量大于0时，长按普攻可使周遭的时间趋于停止。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Slows the surrounding time to near standstill when Hotori is outside of battle and the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> has accumulated energy greater than 0 while holding Basic Attack.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>独行于时间之外，从而得以观察时间的全景。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Walk alone outside of time, and see the truth of time.</>

Description.SourceString: 阿德勒挥动武器，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Wields his weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 阿德勒进入瞄准状态，并对准心范围内的敌人造成<NumGreen>1</>次单体的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Enters aim mode, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of single-target <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to the enemy in the crosshair.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 阿德勒从空中迅速下落冲击地面，落地时造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：度恶」触发。阿德勒闪身躲过攻击后抓住敌人的破绽，迅速挥动武器，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when casting Deliverance after a Critical Dodge. Dodges an attack with a quick dash, seizes the enemy's opening and swiftly swings his weapon, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area, reducing their Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
「度恶」、「无明」命中敌人时，阿德勒会为自身添加<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AdlerYe">「业」</>；
「灭苦」命中敌人时，阿德勒会为自身添加<NumGreen>2</>层「业」；
「业」至多可获得<NumGreen>20</>层。
Description.LocalizedString:
Grants Adler <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AdlerYe">Karma</> when Deliverance or Ignorance hits an enemy.
Grants Adler <NumGreen>2</> stacks of Karma when Liberation hits an enemy.
Max Karma stacks: <NumGreen>20</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
普通攻击：「度恶」、「无明」、「灭苦」命中敌人时获得「业」；
释放变轨技能「诛恶护持」时消耗全部「业」使伤害提升。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Grants Karma when Deliverance, Ignorance, and Liberation hit enemies.
 Consumes all Karma when casting Evil's Bane to increase damage.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>拐杖是一件很称手的饰品，绅士的武器。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>A cane makes for quite the fitting accessory… a gentleman's weapon.</>

Desc.SourceString: 极限闪避反击伤害倍率

Description.SourceString:
需要帮忙吗？阿德勒召唤空若虚影冲击敌方目标，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>后，为敌人施加持续性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，并为前场角色施加「明悟之慧佑」护盾。
阿德勒在释放技能时消耗全部<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AdlerYe">「业」</>的层数，每消耗<NumGreen>1</>层「业」都使得阿德勒的技能伤害提升<NumGreen>2%</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Need help? Summons Sunya phantoms to strike enemies, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area, then inflicting <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> over time on enemies and granting active characters a shield with Blessing.
 Consumes all stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AdlerYe">Karma</> on skill cast. <NumGreen>Each</> stack consumed grants Adler <NumGreen>2%</> Skill DMG.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，为前场角色施加「明悟之慧佑」护盾。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>, granting active characters a shield with Blessing.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>「委托开始前，应先充分了解目标……」</>
<Italic>「柯林斯！出发！」</>
<Italic>「……注意安全，其他工作我来处理。」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>"This commission… let's get to know our target first. We…"</>
<Italic>"Coluccis! Roll out!"</>
<Italic>"…Stay safe, I'll handle everything else."</>

Description.SourceString: 争斗非我所愿。阿德勒召唤「色」「受」「想」「识」「行」<NumGreen>5</>只「空若」冲击敌方全体目标，对每个目标均造成<NumGreen>5</>次<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。当场上仅存单个敌人时，「空若」会进行二次冲击，造成共计<NumGreen>10</>次<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: I wish not fight if possible. Summons Rupa, Vedana, Sanna, Vinnana, and Sankhara, <NumGreen>5</> Sunyas in total, to strike all enemy targets. Each target takes <NumGreen>5</> instances of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. When only a single enemy remains on the field, Sunyas will perform a second strike, dealing a total of <NumGreen>10</> instances of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>在伊波恩里很流行一个「猜猜我是谁」的游戏，据说猜对空若的名字就可以获得阿德勒先生特制甜点一份！</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>The folks at Eibon like to guess the names of Adler's Sunyas. When they guess correctly, Adler rewards them with handmade desserts!</>

Description.SourceString: 缠斗并无意义，该做个了结了。阿德勒瞄准敌人，发射<NumGreen>1</>枚压缩弹，命中敌人时造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: This fight shall not be prolonged any longer. Aims and fires <NumGreen>1</> Compressed Round at the enemy, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area on hit.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「浊燃」强化</>：每次对目标施加「浊燃」时随机附带攻击力降低20%、属性抗性降低10%、倾陷效率提高10%三种负面效果之一，持续15秒，同一效果不可叠加。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Applies one of three random debuffs whenever Scorch is inflicted on a target: -20% ATK, -10% Esper RES, or +10% Break Efficiency, lasting for 15s. The same effect cannot stack.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>熨烫整齐的服装，就算是战斗中，头发也丝毫不乱。外形整洁是管家的第一门必修课。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>A meticulously pressed uniform and even hair, even in battle. The butler's first lesson is to maintain an impeccable appearance.</>

Description.SourceString: 阿德勒的防御提升<NumGreen>20%</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Adler DEF +<NumGreen>20%</>

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「有些时候比起冗长的交涉，强硬的作战战略也是选择之一。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Sometimes a forceful strategy is preferable to lengthy negotiations."</>

Description.SourceString: 精英队员完美的收尾工作！薄荷蓄力跃至空中，对敌人进行穿透攻击，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Perfect finishing work from an elite member! Charges and leaps into the air, performing a penetrating attack on enemies, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
翳以稳健的格斗技法，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
每当命中<NumGreen>1</>个目标，便从自己的影子中分裂出<NumGreen>1</>个 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>对其追击，每个目标最多可同时被<NumGreen>3</>个 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>锁定。
Description.LocalizedString:
Performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks using steady martial arts techniques, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
Splits <NumGreen>1</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> from his shadow to pursue <NumGreen>each</> target hit. Locks each target with up to <NumGreen>3</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> simultaneously.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，命中目标时给目标添加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>，每个目标最多3个。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>. Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> on a target when hit, allowing up to 3 per target.

Description.SourceString: 翳在空中挥舞拳脚，并迅速下落冲击地面，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Strikes in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 从翳的影子中分裂而出，如巨兽利牙般的破碎阴影。会自动追踪并<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&attach">附着</>在目标身上，造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>后消失。
Description.LocalizedString: Splitting from Skia's shadow, these shattered shadows resemble the fangs of a giant beast. They automatically track and <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&attach">attach</> to targets, disappearing after dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成1次<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>后消失。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals 1 instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> then disappears.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：拘管格斗术」触发。翳使用以泼墨般的暗影重击对手，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Arresting Art after a Critical Dodge. Strikes enemies with ink-splash shadows, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「狗狗人……狗狗拳，打出去会有黑乎乎冒出来……很厉害。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"The doggo… This dark stuff comes out with doggo punches… pretty impressive."</>

Description.SourceString:
适合追击行动的工作方式。翳获得 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">「尾追」</>状态，随后跃入自身影子之中，造成<NumGreen>6</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，对于本轮伤害命中的每个目标，从自己的影子中分裂出3个 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>分别对其追击，随后进入 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">「啮逐潜影」</>模式。

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">「尾追」</>
状态期间， <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>对目标造成伤害后不会消失。

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">「啮逐潜影」</>
与「潜影」模式类似，可在地面或墙面上移动。
靠近敌方目标时不会被发现。
该模式下可免疫部分形式的攻击，但被地面伤害命中时会解除模式。
每当触碰已被<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>锁定的敌方目标时，使锁定该目标的 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>发动额外攻击。
在持续期间点按普通攻击或切换角色将退出该模式。
潜行至高处边缘位置若继续向前会解除该模式。
退出该模式时，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
A workflow designed for pursuit. Enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</> state, leaps into own shadow, and deals <NumGreen>6</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area. Splits 3 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from shadow for each target hit, then enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</>
Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from disappearing after dealing damage to targets during the state.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</>
Allows movement on ground or wall surfaces, similar to Shadow Hound mode.
Remains undetected when approaching enemy targets.
Grants immunity to certain attacks, but cancels the mode when hit by ground damage.
Triggers additional attacks from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> whenever touching an enemy already marked by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">them</>.
Press Basic Attack or switch characters to exit this mode during its duration.
Moves forward at the edge of a high place to end this mode.
Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon exiting the mode.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>并进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">「尾追」</>状态，命中给目标添加3个 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>，随后进入 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">「啮逐潜影」</>。

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">「尾追」</>
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>对目标造成伤害后不会消失。

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">「啮逐潜影」</>
该状态会被地面伤害命中并解除；触碰到 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>锁定的目标时，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>发动1次额外攻击；持续期间点按普通攻击或切换角色将退出该模式，并造成1次<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> and enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</> state. Applies 3 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> to the target on hit, then enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</>.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</>
Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from disappearing after dealing damage to targets during the state.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</>
Removes this state when hit by ground damage. Launches 1 additional attack from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> when touching a target marked by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">them</>. Press Basic Attack or switch characters during the duration to exit this mode and deal 1 instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>有些小机灵或许是身手不凡，自以为连E.T.D的追捕都能逃掉……在松一口气之前，还是看看脚下吧。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Some nimble troublemakers might think they can escape ETD's pursuit… They should check what's lurking beneath their feet.</>

Desc.SourceString: 退出「啮逐潜影」伤害倍率
Desc.LocalizedString: Shadow Hound Gnaw Outro DMG Ratio

Description.SourceString:
适合镇压行动的工作方式。翳抛出旋转的打火机，使自身的影子朝地面各方向扩散，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
随后，多重黑影如训练有素的犬只同时奔袭一处，再造成<NumGreen>3</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
释放「极轨终结：群犬吠形」后，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>造成的伤害（包括<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">「啮逐潜影」</>模式下的触碰伤害）提升，每次发动攻击时对目标施加控制效果。
Description.LocalizedString:
A workflow designed for suppression. Throws a spinning lighter, causing his shadow to spread across the ground in all directions, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
Converges multiple shadows on a single location like well-trained canines, dealing <NumGreen>3</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>'s damage after casting The Pack (including collision damage in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode) and inflicts a control effect on targets with each attack.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。

释放后，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>造成的伤害提升，每次命中施加控制效果。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

After casting, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>'s damage is increased, and applies a control effect on each hit.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「拒不配合」的后果。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>The consequences of "non-compliance."</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「延滞」强化</>：<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>锁定「延滞」中目标时，对其额外施加一次「延滞」。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Remora Enhancement</>: Inflicts an additional Remora on a target when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> locks onto them in Remora state.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>毕竟很多情况下无需太多的物理手段，仅靠影子制服对象的话，场地和设施基本上不会受到什么损害，更别提翳自己也会帮忙收拾了……根据在异象管理局食堂展开的问卷调查，84%的员工表示乐意看到翳副队出现在自己工作的现场——这意味着他们能少干好多麻烦事！</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Usually, there's no need for physical intervention—Skia can subdue targets with just his shadows, keeping facilities undamaged. Plus, he helps with cleanup… According to a BAC cafeteria survey, 84% of staff welcome Skia at their work site—less hassle for them!</>

Description.SourceString: 释放「群犬吠形」后的<NumGreen>15</>秒，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">「兽牙影刺」</>造成的伤害（包括<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">「啮逐潜影」</>模式下的触碰伤害）提升<NumGreen>10%</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> damage by <NumGreen>10%</> for <NumGreen>15s</> after casting The Pack, including collision damage in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>明明肉体理应没有任何的不自由，影子却被紧咬不放地牢牢钳制以至于动弹不得……这种体验会很奇妙吧。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Your body might be free to move, but your shadow is held in an iron grip, rendering you immobile… Quite the peculiar sensation.</>

Description.SourceString:
长按方向键和闪避，使翳进入「潜影」模式。

「潜影」
潜藏在自身的影子中，可在地面或墙面上移动。
靠近敌方目标时不会被发现。
该模式下可免疫部分形式的攻击，但被地面伤害命中时会解除模式。
在持续期间点按常轨攻击或切换角色解除该模式。
潜行至高处边缘位置若继续向前会解除该模式。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hold Movement and Dodge to enter Shadow Hound mode

Shadow Hound
Lurks within his shadow, allowing movement on ground and wall surfaces.
Cannot be detected by enemies.
Grants immunity to certain attacks, but ends if hit by ground damage.
Press Basic Attack or switch characters to cancel.
Reaching the edge of elevated positions and moving forward also cancels the mode.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 长按方向键和闪避，使翳进入「潜影」模式，点按普攻或者切换角色退出。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold Movement and Dodge to make Skia enter Shadow Hound mode. Press Basic Attack or switch characters to exit.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>法帝娅问过翳，当他整个身子潜在影子里的时候，他体感实际上是一个怎样的姿势。翳形容不上来，便答任君想象。另外，他一点儿也不想了解法帝娅所想象出的画面。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Fadia once asked Skia what position his body feels like when submerged in shadows. Unable to describe it, Skia told her to use her imagination. He'd rather not know what images that sparked in her mind.</>

Description.SourceString: 穷追不舍的影子无法被甩开。翳以指挥警犬的方式指示影子撕咬目标，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: The relentless shadows cannot be shaken off. Commands the shadow like a police canine to bite the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.

Description.SourceString: 白藏使用体术，进行至多五段的连续攻击，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Uses martial arts to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
在「言行合一」第<NumGreen>1</>段、第<NumGreen>2</>段攻击后长按「普通攻击」，可触发「无状之言」。
在战斗状态下松开操作杆并长按闪避，可触发「无状之言」。
白藏横向飞射出<NumGreen>3</>枚咒令，短暂延迟后引爆咒令，每枚咒令对目标造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hold Basic Attack to trigger Formless Words after the <NumGreen>1st</> and <NumGreen>2nd</> hits of Walk the Talk.
Release the stick and hold Dodge to trigger Formless Words during battle.
Fires <NumGreen>3</> incantation commands horizontally. After a brief delay, the commands detonate, with each dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
在「言行合一」第<NumGreen>3</>段攻击后长按「普通攻击」，可触发「无讳之语」。
在战斗状态下按住操作杆并长按闪避，可触发「无讳之语」。
白藏纵向飞射出<NumGreen>3</>枚咒令，短暂延迟后引爆咒令，每枚咒令对目标造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hold Basic Attack to trigger Unrestrained Words after the <NumGreen>3rd</> hit of Walk the Talk.
Hold down the stick and hold Dodge to trigger Unrestrained Words during battle.
Fires <NumGreen>3</> incantation commands vertically. After a brief delay, the commands detonate, with each dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 白藏跃起于风中施展拳脚，落地后对目标造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Leaps in the wind and strikes, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「言行合一」触发。白藏膝顶攻击目标，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。命中时，目标身上将生成<NumGreen>1</>个<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">「祝」</>字。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when casting Walk the Talk after a Critical Dodge. Performs a knee strike on the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area, reducing their Break. Generates <NumGreen>1</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">Bless</> word on the target when hit.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
当「言行合一」每<NumGreen>3</>次命中目标时，敌方身上将生成言灵字<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">「祝」</>，该字存在<NumGreen>15</>秒且最多生成<NumGreen>3</>个。
出现任意言灵字时，白藏消耗<NumGreen>3%</>当前生命值。当白藏的生命值低于<NumGreen>50%</>时，该消耗减半。
Description.LocalizedString:
Generates a Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">Bless</> on the enemy for every <NumGreen>3</> Walk the Talk hits. This word lasts for <NumGreen>15s</>, and a maximum of <NumGreen>3</> can be generated.
Consumes <NumGreen>3%</> of Baicang's current HP whenever any Power Word is summoned. When Baicang's HP is below <NumGreen>50%</>, the amount consumed is halved.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 生成言灵字<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">「祝」</>，同时消耗白藏生命值。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Generates Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">Bless</> while consuming Baicang's HP.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>一点拳脚功夫而已。幼时在家族的规训下日复一日地做着训练，直到少年的臂膀逐渐硬朗、宽厚。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Just some really basic moves. Day after day of training under family discipline since childhood, the young boy's arms have become strong and broad.</>

Description.SourceString: 言与文自地脉而生，向目标位置汇聚并释放攻击。
Description.LocalizedString: Words and text emerge from the ley lines, converge at the target location, and unleash an attack.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
触发闪避后点击「变轨技能」触发。
对单体目标释放攻击，命中造成单体<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，攻击命中后在目标身上生成<NumGreen>1</>个<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">「噤」</>字。
Description.LocalizedString:
Press Redirect Skill after triggering a dodge.
Attacks a single target, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to them on hit. Generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</> on the target when attacks hit.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，生成<NumGreen>1</>个<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">「噤」</>字。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</>.

Description.SourceString:
触发「普通攻击：无状之言」或「普通攻击：无讳之语」后点击「变轨技能」触发。
伤害范围扩大，命中造成范围<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，攻击命中后在目标附近地面生成<NumGreen>1</>个<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangLi">「詈」</>字。
Description.LocalizedString:
Press Redirect Skill after triggering Formless Words or Unrestrained Words.
Expanded the damage range, dealing AoE <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> on hit. Generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangLi">Objurgate</> on the ground near the target when attacks hit.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，生成<NumGreen>1</>个<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangLi">「詈」</>字。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> Generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangLi">Objurgate</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>每一击都带着诚意。曾找回的声音，曾短暂拥有的归宿——将对逝者的缅怀藏于心间，微笑吧！如今他已有了可以「保护」别人的力量。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Every strike carries genuine intent. The voice once found, the home once briefly held, keeping memories of the departed close to heart. Smile! For now he has to power to protect.</>

Desc.LocalizedString: "Heart of Heaven and Earth" DMG Ratio

Desc.SourceString: 「噤念」「如此罪状」共享冷却时间
Desc.LocalizedString: Silenced Thought / Such Crime Shared CD

Description.SourceString:
抬头，坠入两极深渊。白藏释放领域，进入言灵状态，对目标造成持续<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
当目标生命值低于<NumGreen>10%</>时（BOSS生命值低于<NumGreen>5%</>），白藏发动「即刻斩杀」击败目标。
在「判予秋」期间，白藏可暂时免疫一次致命伤害，并记录数值。触发免疫效果后，领域将在<NumGreen>3</>秒后自动结束，并在结束后的<NumGreen>10</>秒内，缓慢扣除记录的伤害值。
在领域内，可触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">「噤」</>字造成单体高伤害；可触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangLi">「詈」</>字造成群体伤害；可触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">「祝」</>字造成单体伤害，并回复白藏<NumGreen>5%</>最大生命值。
Description.LocalizedString:
Look up, and fall into the polar abyss. Releases a domain and enters Power Word state, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> over time to targets.
Executes the target when their HP is below <NumGreen>10%</> (Boss HP below <NumGreen>5%</>).
Becomes immune to one fatal hit temporarily during Judgment of Autumn and records its value. Ends the domain automatically <NumGreen>3</>s after triggering the immunity effect and takes the recorded damage slowly over <NumGreen>10</>s after ending.
Deals high single-target damage within the domain when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</> is triggered; Deals AoE DMG when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangLi">Objurgate</> is triggered; Deals damage to a single target and restores <NumGreen>5%</> of Baicang's Max HP when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">Bless</> is triggered.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
斩杀低血量目标。
免疫一次致命伤害。
触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">「噤」</>、<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangLi">「詈」</>、<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">「祝」</>字。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
Executes low HP targets.
Blocks one fatal hit.
Triggers Power Words <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</>, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangLi">Objurgate</>, and <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">Bless</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>没有人比白藏更明白言语本身的力量。不到最后一刻谁都不知道，那种在空气中形成波形的东西究竟代表的是「恶诅」还是「祝祷」。或许——窥见人心才得以所察。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>No one understands the power of words themselves better than Baicang. Until the very last moment, no one knows whether those waveforms taking shape in the air represent curses or blessings. Perhaps—only by glimpsing into the heart can one truly discern.</>

Desc.LocalizedString: Judgment of Autumn Expansion DMG Ratio
Judgment of Autumn DoT DMG Ratio

Description.SourceString: 见识一下文字所赋予的。白藏短暂蓄力书写咒令，指向目标并造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。攻击命中时，在目标身上生成<NumGreen>1</>个言灵字<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">「噤」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Witness the power that words bestow. Charges briefly and writes incantation commands, targeting enemies and dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area. Generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</> on target when attacks hit.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
生成<NumGreen>1</>个言灵字<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">「噤」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
Generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</>.

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「浊燃」强化</>：处于「浊燃」状态下的目标被生成言灵字时，对目标再施加一次与已有效果相同的「浊燃」。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Inflicts another instance of Scorch with the same effect as the existing one when a Power Word is generated on a target affected by Scorch.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>唉……摸鱼时间又结束了。接下来，还请速战速决好吗？</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Sigh… break time's over again. Now then, let's wrap this up quickly, shall we?</>

Description.SourceString:
白藏攻击力提升<NumGreen>20%</>；
当队伍中有禁制机动队四队成员时，白藏可与队员们协同作战。
战斗状态下，翳在潜行期间切换白藏，可直接触发白藏的一次攻击并在目标身上生成1个言灵字<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">「噤」</>，冷却<NumGreen>30</>秒。
战斗状态下，法帝娅的生命值低于<NumGreen>20%</>时，白藏会上场攻击敌方<NumGreen>1</>次，治疗法帝娅<NumGreen>1</>次，并在目标身上生成<NumGreen>1</>个言灵字<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">「噤」</>，冷却<NumGreen>30</>秒。
安魂曲在蝙蝠状态期间切换白藏，可触发<NumGreen>1</>次白藏的超级跳跃。
Description.LocalizedString:
Increases Baicang's ATK by <NumGreen>20%</>.
Launches coordinate attacks with the allies when there are ETD-4 members in the Team.
In combat, switching to Baicang while Skia is in stealth to immediately attack with Baicang and generate 1 Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</> on target. Cooldown: <NumGreen>30s</>.
In combat, when Fadia's HP drops below <NumGreen>20%</>, Baicang attacks the enemy <NumGreen>1</> time, heals Fadia <NumGreen>1</> time, and generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</> on target. Cooldown: <NumGreen>30s</>.
Switching to Baicang while Lacrimosa is in bat form can trigger <NumGreen>1</> super jump for Baicang.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>虽说都是一群我行我素的怪人，但也有合作默契的时刻。相处久了，身体也会记住对方的习性和动作。刚刚那算什么？当然是禁制机动队四队「热血的组合技」！</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Sure, we're all a bunch of eccentric weirdos who do our own thing, but we have our moments of perfect teamwork too. Spend enough time together, and your body starts to remember each other's habits and movements. What was that just now? Why, that was ETD-4's passionate combo, of course!</>

Description.SourceString: 哈索尔施展高超的体术，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Displays superior martial arts, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 哈索尔滞空时俯身冲刺，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Plunges from the air, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 长按普通攻击触发，哈索尔将环绕目标高速飞行，卷起强风将其击至空中，随后压制目标从上空急坠，重击目标坠地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，若目标不可浮空则转为触发「普通攻击：压轴派送」。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack to trigger. Sweeps around the target at high speed to knock them up, then restrains and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area on impact. Performs Final Dispatch if the target cannot be knocked up.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 浮空并击落目标造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，若目标不可浮空则触发「普通攻击：压轴派送」。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Knocks the target up and slams them down, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>. If the target cannot be knocked up, Final Dispatch is triggered instead.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：高频送达」触发。哈索尔向敌人发起极速反击，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值，命中后获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>，<NumGreen>5</>秒内最多获取<NumGreen>1</>次。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Rapid Delivery after a Critical Dodge. Launches a lightning-fast counterattack, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area, reducing Break, and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> on hit (up to <NumGreen>1</> stack every <NumGreen>5s</>).

ShortDescription.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后普通攻击，造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，命中获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>，<NumGreen>5</>秒获取冷却。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Basic Attack after a Critical Dodge. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> on hit. Cooldown: <NumGreen>5</>s.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「传说中，唯有完成上万次零误差投递的精英快递员，才能掌握的隐秘技艺。以近乎本能的出击节奏，撕碎一切阻碍在派送路径上的障碍，只为不失约、不失信的一次送达。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Legend speaks of a secret art mastered only by Elite Couriers who have completed tens of thousands of flawless deliveries. With an almost instinctive striking rhythm, they tear through any obstacle blocking the delivery route, all to ensure a single successful delivery without breaking promises or trust.</>

Description.SourceString:
目标已锁定，速战速决。哈索尔飞身跃击，使用翅膀凌空斩击前方目标，释放后可获得<NumGreen>2</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>。
长按激活后，哈索尔进入蓄力状态，提高「空中指令」的技能威力，并强制范围内的目标陷入<TextEXPL>「满星追踪」</>效果。蓄力最多持续5秒，期间哈索尔持续造成范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，同时技能范围逐渐扩大。松开技能按钮后，蓄力阶段结束。
 <TextHLT>「满星追踪」</>
持续5秒，在效果持续期间，若目标主动攻击或命中我方，哈索尔将获得 3 层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Target locked, time to wrap this up quickly. Leaps into the air and slashes the target in front with wings, gaining <NumGreen>2</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>.
Hold to enter charge status, increasing the power of Aerial Command and inflicting targets in range with <TextEXPL>Five-Star Tracking</> effect. The charge lasts up to 5s, during which Hathor constantly deals AoE <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> while the skill range gradually expands. The effect ends when the skill button is released, concluding the charging phase.
<TextHLT>Five-Star Tracking</>
Lasts for 5s. Grants 3 stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> when the target attacks or hits Hathor or an ally during this time.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
释放后造成伤害并获得<NumGreen>2</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>。
长按进入蓄力状态，提高威力并使范围内的目标陷入<TextEXPL>「满星追踪」</>效果。蓄力最多5秒，期间持续造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，同时技能范围逐渐扩大。松开按钮蓄力结束。
 <TextHLT>「满星追踪」</>
持续5秒，期间若目标主动攻击或命中我方，哈索尔获得 3 层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Casts to deal damage and grant <NumGreen>2</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>.
Hold to enter charge status, increasing the skill power and inflicting all targets within range with <TextEXPL>Five-Star Tracking</> effect. Charge lasts up to 5s. During this time, continuously deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> while the skill range gradually expands. Release the button to end the charge.
<TextHLT>Five-Star Tracking</>
Lasts for 5s. Grants 3 stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> when the target attacks or hits Hathor or an ally during this time.

Description.SourceString: 在<TextEXPL>「紧急派送」</>状态下，消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>可释放此技能。哈索尔召唤由荆棘构成的摩托车，对目标发动高速连段攻击，技能期间自身防御力提升。
Description.LocalizedString: Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> to cast this skill while in <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> status. Summons a motorcycle of thorns and unleashes a rapid combo on the target. Increases DEF while the skill is active.

ShortDescription.SourceString: <TextEXPL>「紧急派送」</>状态下，消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>释放，对目标发动连段攻击，自身防御力提升。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> to cast this skill while in <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> status, unleashing a combo on the target. Increases DEF.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>为了确保快递在时限内完成，在半路将敌人强制清除，也是任务的基本守则之一。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>To ensure delivery within the time limit, forcibly eliminating enemies along the way is also one of the basic principles of the job.</>
