Description.SourceString:
别挡路。哈索尔召唤由荆棘构成的摩托车，并环绕加速冲撞前方目标，然后驾驶摩托车腾空而起俯冲砸向地面，并造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
技能释放一段时间内，哈索尔进入 <TextHLT>「紧急派送」</>状态并不再获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>。该状态下，「变轨技能：空中指令」升级为「变轨技能：轮转打击」，移动速度提升并根据<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>层数获得攻击力加成，期间更换角色将立即解除 <TextHLT>「紧急派送」</>状态。
Description.LocalizedString:
Get out of the way. Summons a motorcycle made of thorns and circles around targets, charging at enemies ahead with increased speed. Launches into the air and dive-bombs the ground, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
Enters <TextHLT>Emergency Delivery</> state for a period after skill activation and stops gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>. Upgrades Aerial Command to Cyclone Strike in this state. Increases Movement Speed and grants ATK bonus based on <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> stacks. Ends <TextHLT>Emergency Delivery</> state immediately when switching characters during this period.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
召唤摩托车造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
释放后哈索尔进入 <TextHLT>「紧急派送」</>状态并不再获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>。该状态下，「变轨技能：空中指令」升级为「变轨技能：轮转打击」，移动速度提升并获得攻击力加成，更换角色将立即解除 <TextHLT>「紧急派送」</>状态。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Summons a motorcycle and deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
Enters  <TextHLT>Emergency Delivery</> state after casting and stops gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>. Upgrades Aerial Command to Cyclone Strike in this state. Increases Movement Speed and grants ATK bonus. Removes <TextHLT>Emergency Delivery</> state immediately when switching characters.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「加速、加速、再加速。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Faster. Faster. Faster…!"</>

Desc.SourceString: 每层「闪送之力」攻击力加成
Desc.LocalizedString: Express Delivery Power ATK Bonus per Stack

Description.SourceString: 时机已到。哈索尔从空中突袭，踢击目标引发冲击，造成<NumGreen>2</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: The time has come. Strikes from the air, kicking the target to trigger an impact, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 从空中突袭踢击目标，造成<NumGreen>2</>次<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Performs an aerial dive kick on the target, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「就是现在。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Right now.</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「延滞」强化</>：目标受到「延滞」影响时间延长至12秒，全队角色攻击受「延滞」影响的目标时暴击率提升10%。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>「延滞」强化</>：目标受到「延滞」影响时间延长至12秒，全队角色攻击受「延滞」影响的目标时暴击率提升10%。

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「有延时风险，我来处理。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Can't risk the delay. I'll handle it.</>

Description.SourceString: 哈索尔每次击败目标后，获得<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> after defeating a target.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「还可以更快。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>I can go faster.</>

Description.SourceString:
当哈索尔在队伍中时，若敌方在其附近范围内停留超过<NumGreen>5</>秒，将触发<TextHLT>「优评锁定」</>效果。
<TextHLT>优评锁定</>：激活后效果持续<NumGreen>5</>秒，处于该状态的目标在持续时间内若主动向我方发动攻击，<TextHLT>「优评锁定」</>将被移除，哈索尔获得<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">「闪送之力」</>（最多叠加<NumGreen>6</>层）。
Description.LocalizedString:
Triggers <TextHLT>Excellent Rating Lock</> when Hathor is in the team and enemies remain nearby for more than <NumGreen>5s</>.
<TextHLT>Excellent Rating Lock</>: Lasts <NumGreen>5s</> after activation. If a target under this status attacks your team during this duration, <TextHLT>Excellent Rating Lock</> is removed, and Hathor gains <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> (up to <NumGreen>6</> stacks).

Description.SourceString: 「风险在途上解决，才不会影响结果。」
Description.LocalizedString: Deal with the risks in the process, so the results can be perfect.

Description.SourceString: 零挥动武器牵引能量，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Channels energy through the weapon, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks that deal <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 零在空中挥动武器，并迅速下落冲击地面，落地时造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Wields the weapon mid-air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：鉴痕·断」触发。零抓住敌人攻击落空的破绽挥动武器进行反击，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Appraisal - Severance after a Critical Dodge. Seizes the opening from the enemy's missed attack and swings the weapon to counter, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后普通攻击，造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> with Basic Attacks after a Critical Dodge.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>使用剑的方法，是那时唯独能感觉到握于手中的东西。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Handling a sword is the only way I feel in control.</>

Description.SourceString: 破绽，于此揭露！零连续挥动武器造成<NumGreen>3</>段伤害并跃至空中蓄力，发射一枚「异能炮」，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，并对命中的第一个等级低于零自身等级的敌人额外造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Opening, exposed! Performs <NumGreen>3</> consecutive weapon strikes. Leaps into the air to charge. Fires an Esper Cannon that deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area. Deals an additional <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the first enemy hit whose level is below Zero's own level.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，对命中的第1个不高于自身等级的敌人造成额外1次<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>, dealing an additional instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the first enemy hit that is not higher level than the caster.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>超脱现实之景，由斩击浅浅刻画出一角，显现于凭空。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>A surreal scene, outlined in slashes, emerges from thin air.</>

Description.SourceString: 将只有自己能看见的连结奇点之线——以舞动般的剑法一扫俱尽，造成多次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Sweeps away the unseen lines that connect the Nexus in a dance of blades. Deals multiple instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>感应到的异象奇点，环绕着无形、无声、无味的纽带……以流丽的招式全数切断，只消一瞬。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>I sense an Anomaly Nexus, bound by invisible, silent, intangible ties… All severed in an instant with a single graceful strike.</>

Description.SourceString: 以宛同切割空间之势发动斩击，引爆破绽的裂隙，造成<NumGreen>2</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Slashes through space and detonates a rift, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.LocalizedString: Channels energy through the weapon, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks that deal <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 零在空中挥动武器，并迅速下落冲击地面，落地时造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Wields the weapon mid-air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：鉴痕·断」触发。零抓住敌人攻击落空的破绽挥动武器进行反击，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Appraisal - Severance after a Critical Dodge. Seizes the opening from the enemy's missed attack and swings the weapon to counter, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后普通攻击，造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> with Basic Attacks after a Critical Dodge.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>使用剑的方法，是那时唯独能感觉到握于手中的东西。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Handling a sword is the only way I feel in control.</>

Description.SourceString: 破绽，于此揭露！零连续挥动武器造成<NumGreen>3</>段伤害并跃至空中蓄力，发射一枚「异能炮」，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，并对命中的第一个等级低于零自身等级的敌人额外造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Opening, exposed! Performs <NumGreen>3</> consecutive weapon strikes. Leaps into the air to charge. Fires an Esper Cannon that deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area. Deals an additional <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the first enemy hit whose level is below Zero's own level.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，对命中的第1个不高于自身等级的敌人造成额外1次<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>, dealing an additional instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the first enemy hit that is not higher level than the caster.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>超脱现实之景，由斩击浅浅刻画出一角，显现于凭空。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>A surreal scene, outlined in slashes, emerges from thin air.</>

Description.SourceString: 将只有自己能看见的连结奇点之线——以舞动般的剑法一扫俱尽，造成多次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Sweeps away the unseen lines that connect the Nexus in a dance of blades. Deals multiple instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>感应到的异象奇点，环绕着无形、无声、无味的纽带……以流丽的招式全数切断，只消一瞬。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>I sense an Anomaly Nexus, bound by invisible, silent, intangible ties… All severed in an instant with a single graceful strike.</>

Description.SourceString: 以宛同切割空间之势发动斩击，引爆破绽的裂隙，造成<NumGreen>2</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Slashes through space and detonates a rift, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 埃德嘉活用「灯校」体术课的学习成果，进行至多五段的连续攻击，造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Applies what he learned in Lamplight Academy's physical education class to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks that deal <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

DescriptionTitle.SourceString: <Title>普通攻击：精心计算后的着陆</>

Description.SourceString: 埃德嘉滞空时点按普攻，落地时造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
触发极限闪避后点击「普通攻击：体术实战」触发。
埃德嘉冲向目标，通过书包使用「流」造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString:
Triggers when using Combat Practice after a Critical Dodge.
Charges toward the target and uses his backpack to unleash a Flow attack, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>一定有某种更高效、更温柔的收容方式存在着。但在埃德嘉找到这种方法前，他不得不采取略显粗暴的手段。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Edgar believes there must be a more humane way to contain them. Until that solution is found, he is forced to rely on rougher methods.</>

Description.SourceString:
长按进入持续状态，向目标持续使用「流」，造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>并持续治疗生命值最低的队友。
「变轨技能：狂流」的冷却时间会随使用时长而增加。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hold to enter a channeling state, continuously casting Current at the target, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and continuously healing the teammate with the lowest HP.
The CD of Redirect Skill: Wild Current increases based on the duration of use.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，治疗生命值最低队友。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>, heals the teammate with the lowest HP.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>治疗工作是很重要的。埃德嘉发现这条自游戏里总结的规律在现实中也适用。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Healing is important work. Edgar realized that the rules he learned from games apply in real life as well.</>

Desc.SourceString: 额外每段延长的冷却时间

Description.SourceString: 埃德嘉沉浸在自己思绪中，释放迷宫般的领域。造成1次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，领域维持10秒，期间持续治疗当前角色。
Description.LocalizedString: Immerses in his own thoughts, unleashing a labyrinthine domain for 10s. Deals 1 instance of AoE <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Heals the current character over the domain's duration.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，持续治疗当前角色。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and heals the current character continuously.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>总是在好奇，总是在提问。埃德嘉一不留神就会陷入沉思，把他从迷宫般复杂的思考中拖出来真不是件容易事。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Always curious, always questioning. Edgar often slips into deep thought without warning. Pulling him out of his complex musings is no easy task.</>

Description.SourceString: 这个书包真的很沉。埃德嘉冲向目标，使劲挥动书包对目标造成1次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: This bag is really heavy. Edgar charges toward the target and swings his bag with all his might, dealing 1 instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「盈蓄」强化</>：使用援护技触发「盈蓄」的角色在触发瞬间获得120点终结能量，后续创生花命中迟缓中目标时不再提供终结能量，此效果冷却时间30秒。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Grants 120 Ultimate Energy instantly when a character triggers Charge using a Support Skill. Disables Ultimate Energy gain from Vita Pistils when hitting Slowed targets afterward. Cooldown: 30s.

ShortDescription.SourceString: <TextHLT>「盈蓄」强化</>：使用援护技触发「盈蓄」的角色在触发瞬间获得120点终结能量，后续创生花命中迟缓中目标时不再提供终结能量，此效果冷却时间30秒。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Grants 120 Ultimate Energy instantly when a character triggers Charge using a Support Skill. Disables Ultimate Energy gain from Vita Pistils when hitting Slowed targets afterward. Cooldown: 30s.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>天才大抵都有些傲气，埃德嘉也不例外。并非张扬到让人难以接近的锐意，温和内敛的小小锋芒，支撑他一路走来。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Like many geniuses, Edgar carries a quiet pride. Unlike most, his brilliance is gentle and understated, guiding him through every challenge he has faced.</>

Description.SourceString:
释放「变轨技能：狂流」或「援护技：知识的重量」后可获得一把「真理之匙」，最多可获得三把；
每把「真理之匙」可延长1秒「极轨终结：芬尼根守灵夜」持续时间。
Description.LocalizedString:
Cast Redirect Skill Wild Current or Support Skill Weight of Knowledge to gain a Key of Truth, up to 3 keys.
Each Key of Truth extends the duration of Ultimate: Finnegan's Vigil by 1s.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
释放「变轨技能：狂流」或「援护技：知识的重量」后可获得一把「真理之匙」，最多可获得三把；
每把「真理之匙」可延长1秒「极轨终结：芬尼根守灵夜」持续时间。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Cast Redirect Skill Wild Current or Support Skill Weight of Knowledge to gain a Key of Truth, up to 3 keys.
Each Key of Truth extends the duration of Ultimate: Finnegan's Vigil by 1s.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>每当埃德嘉看到伊波恩亮起融融灯火，心中就会涌现暖意。幸运的是，它是这瞬息万变的世界中，难得坚定不变的存在。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Whenever Edgar sees the warm lights of Eibon, comfort rises in his heart. In an ever-changing world, this warmth remains a constant.</>

Description.SourceString: 九原使用双枪进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。过程中可获得<NumGreen>2</>颗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">「玫约子弹」</>，最后一击命中目标时与目标达成<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">「致命玫约」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Dual-wields to perform up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Grants <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>. Establishes a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> with the target when the final hit strikes.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 九原滞空时握持双枪，并迅速下落冲击地面，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Wields her weapon while airborne and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 长按普通攻击触发，九原将自动锁定目标射击单发子弹造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。若九原持有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">「玫约子弹」</>，则自动消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">「玫约子弹」</>进行连续射击，并优先攻击带有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">「致命玫约」</>的目标。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack to trigger. Auto-targets and fires a bullet, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> for continuous fire and prioritizes targets with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> are available.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。可自动消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">「玫约子弹」</>连续射击，并优先攻击带有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">「致命玫约」</>的目标。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> for continuous fire and prioritizes targets with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</>.

Description.SourceString: 按下瞄准键使九原进入瞄准状态，向准心方向射出一发子弹对敌人造成<NumGreen>1</>次单体的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>
Description.LocalizedString: Press Aim to enter Aim mode. Fires a bullet that deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to the enemy in the crosshair.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<NumGreen>1</>次单体的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：秘密成型时」触发，九原甩动双臂交叉射击前方范围目标，对当前目标缔结一次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">「致命玫约」</>同时造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值，并获得<NumGreen>2</>颗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">「玫约子弹」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using When Secrets Take Shape after a Critical Dodge. Swings both arms and fires in a cross pattern at targets in front, binding them with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> while dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</>, reducing Break, and granting <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后普通攻击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并获得<NumGreen>2</>颗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">「玫约子弹」</>
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</> with Basic Attacks after a Critical Dodge. Grants <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「在无数次的情报交易与秘密行动中，她游走于城市光影交错之处，凭借风声与线索收拢万物，只为让每一次交易圆满达成。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"She glides through the city like a phantom, where light and shadow dance. Weaving secrets from whispers and fleeting leads, every move is a quiet vow to seal each deal in flawless harmony."</>

Desc.SourceString: 长按普攻射击伤害倍率
Desc.LocalizedString: 长按普攻射击伤害倍率

Desc.SourceString: 「玫约子弹」每段射击伤害倍率
Desc.LocalizedString: 「玫约子弹」每段射击伤害倍率

Desc.SourceString: 自动「致约清算」伤害倍率

Description.SourceString: 九原穿梭战场，对目标造成伤害同时将其强制拉入掌控范围后发起攻击，对敌人造成多段<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>并获得<NumGreen>4</>颗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">「玫约子弹」</>同时缔结<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">「致命玫约」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Dashes across the battlefield, pulling the target into the range of control and attacking. Deals multiple instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and grants <NumGreen>4</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> while establishing a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 聚拢目标，造成伤害,获得<NumGreen>4</>颗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">「玫约子弹」</>并缔结<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">「致命玫约」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Gathers targets, deals damage, grants <NumGreen>4</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>, and establishes a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「我们很擅长，解决麻烦~」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>We're pretty good at solving problems.</>

Description.SourceString:
九原高速穿梭战场，对周围目标展开连续射击，最终以大范围爆炸收束战局，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
「极轨终结：终局清账」会令范围内所有已缔结<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">「致命玫约」</>的目标进入可发起<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">「致约清算」</>的阶段，并在「极轨终结：终局清账」的最后一段伤害时统一清算
Description.LocalizedString:
Dashes across the battlefield at high speed, continuously firing on surrounding targets before ending with a large-scale explosion, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Triggers Final Reckoning, causing all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> targets within range to enter a stage where <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</> can be triggered, executing all settlements simultaneously on the final hit.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成大范围<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并对范围内所有已缔结<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">「致命玫约」</>的目标进入发起<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">「致约清算」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals large-scale <Ling>Anima DMG</> and causes all targets within range bound by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> to undergo <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「有点动静。可惜……也只是稍纵即逝的对手。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>A faint stir in the air. Alas… merely a fleeting foe.</>

Description.SourceString: 九原甩射一枚曲线子弹，命中后造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并获得<NumGreen>2</>颗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">「玫约子弹」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Fires a curved bullet, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and granting <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> upon hit.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并获得<NumGreen>2</>颗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">「玫约子弹」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and grants <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「放心，我的记忆一向很好。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Don't worry, I've always had an excellent memory.</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「创生」强化</>：额外生成1株创生株，场上创生株的存在上限提升至6株。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Spawns 1 additional Vita Bud and increases Vita Bud limit on field to 6.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「交易顺利，一切如我所料。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Went as smoothly as I thought it would.</>

Description.SourceString:
小吱长按「普通攻击：荒谷」投出「黑糖波波」吞噬目标，对目标造成2次光属性异能伤害，并获得一定数量的「金谷」和方斯，每2.5秒最多触发一次。
「普通攻击：荒谷」可在任意一段「普通攻击：失乡剑术」攻击时长按进行派生，对目标造成2次光属性异能伤害，并获得一定数量的「金谷」和方斯。
若本次伤害成功击杀目标，则可以额外获得方斯。
达到当日高效收益方斯上限时，每次通过这种方式可获得1方斯。通过这种方式最多获得25万方斯，「大亨等级」提升至25级后，获取总上限提升至50万方斯。达到总上限后，无法通过该方式继续获得方斯。
Description.LocalizedString:
Press Blighted Vale to throw Brown Sugar Boba to devour the target, dealing 2 instance of Cosmos DMG, granting a certain amount of Grain and Fons. Triggers up to once every 2.5s.
Hold Blighted Vale during any instance of Exiled Swordplay attacks to create a branch attack, dealing 2 instance of Cosmos DMG and granting a certain amount of Grain and Fons.
Grants bonus Fons if this skill defeats the target.
Up to 250,000 Fons can be earned this way. Increasing the Tycoon Level to 25 raises the cap to 500,000 Fons. Grants 1 Fons per use once the daily cap is reached. After reaching the total limit, no more Fons can be obtained this way.

通过这种方式获得的方斯存在每日上限和总额上限，可通过提升「大亨等级」提高获取上限。

Description.SourceString:
多、多多、多多多益善。小吱的变轨技能可累积使用次数，至多可累积3次。

点按变轨技能时，将消耗1次技能使用次数，释放「变轨技能：空仓」，对目标造成1次光属性异能伤害。连续点按变轨技能时，将依据点按次数消耗对应的技能使用次数，并依次释放「变轨技能：空仓」、「变轨技能：半仓」、「变轨技能：满仓」，至多可连续释放3次。
当小吱处于<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes2">「盈余」</>状态时，点按释放「变轨技能：粉爪在上原则」，每段变轨技能将依据小吱持有的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">「金谷」</>数对目标额外造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，伤害不可暴击。

长按变轨技能时，将消耗2次技能使用次数，释放「变轨技能：空仓」和「变轨技能：半仓」。「变轨技能：半仓」攻击期间将持续消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">「金谷」</>，并依据消耗的「金谷」数对目标造成额外的连续<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，伤害不可暴击。「变轨技能：半仓」攻击持续时间结束时，将消耗小吱持有的全部「金谷」（包含<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes3">「负债」</>状态下的全部<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">「金谷贷款」</>）。可再次点按变轨技能，消耗1次技能使用次数，提前结束「变轨技能：半仓」，不再消耗「金谷」并释放「变轨技能：满仓」。持续长按变轨技能时，将消耗3次技能使用次数，消耗小吱持有的全部「金谷」（包含「负债」状态下的全部「金谷贷款」），并依次释放「变轨技能：空仓」、「变轨技能：半仓」、「变轨技能：满仓」。
当小吱处于「盈余」状态时，长按释放「变轨技能：粉爪在上原则」，将依据小吱持有的「金谷」数使得「变轨技能：空仓」对目标额外造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，伤害不可暴击。
Description.LocalizedString:
The more, the merrier; the more, the better.nStacks Redirect Skill attempts, up to 3 stacks

Press Redirect Skill to consume 1 stack and cast No Grain, dealing Cosmos DMG once. Press Redirect Skill consecutively to consume stacks and cast No Grain, Half Grain, and Full Grain in order, up to 3 times in a row.
Press to cast Pink Paws Priority Principle while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes2">Surplus</> state, dealing bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on available <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> using Redirect Skills. Cannot Crit.

Hold Redirect Skill to consume 2 stacks and cast No Grain and Half Grain. Continuously consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> while Half Grain is active, dealing consecutive bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on available Grains. Cannot Crit. Consumes all available Grains (including all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">Grain Loans</> from the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes3">Debt</> state) when Half Grain ends. Press Redirect Skill again to consume 1 stack and end Half Grain early, allowing Full Grain to be cast without consuming Grains. Hold Redirect Skill to consume 3 stacks and use all available Grains (including all Grain Loans from the Debt state). Casts No Grain, Half Grain, and Full Grain in order.
Hold to cast Pink Paws Priority Principle while Surplus is active, dealing bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> with No Grain based on remaining Grains. Cannot Crit.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
变轨技能最多可累积使用3次。

点按时，可连续释放3段技能并消耗对应的技能次数，对目标造成基于当前金谷数的额外<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，伤害不可暴击。

长按时，可连续释放3段技能并消耗对应的技能次数，并在第二段时持续消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">「金谷」</>，依据消耗的「金谷」数对目标造成额外的连续<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，伤害不可暴击。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Redirect Skill can accumulate up to 3 charges.

Press consecutively to cast 3 instances of the skill, consuming corresponding skill charges and dealing additional <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the target based on current Grain count. Cannot Crit.

Hold to consecutively cast 3 instances of the skill, consuming corresponding skill charges. During the second instance, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</> is continuously consumed, dealing consecutive bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on the Grain consumed. Cannot Crit.

Description.SourceString:
事已至此，拉满杠杆吧！小吱投出「黑糖波波」撞击敌人，立刻造成1次范围性的<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，并进入「金谷市场」，持续7秒，期间第1次「谷价结算」的伤害必定暴击。
释放「极轨终结：零和博弈」后，剩余的全部<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">「金谷贷款」</>都将转化成<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">「金谷」</>，并进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes2">「盈余」</>状态。小吱将全部的「金谷」投入「金谷市场」，并在点按使用「变轨技能：粉爪至上原则」时，根据当前的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes5">「金谷K线」</>波动参与<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes6">「谷价结算」</>，获得对应的「金谷」数；若长按使用「变轨技能：粉爪至上原则」，则仅根据按下时的「金谷K线」值进行一次「谷价结算」。
当「金谷市场」持续时间结束时，小吱将退出「金谷市场」，当前持有全部的「金谷」将优先偿还「金谷贷款」。
小吱处于<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes3">「负债」</>状态且「金谷贷款」不为0时，也可进入「金谷市场」。
Description.LocalizedString:
No turning back, max the leverage. Throws Brown Sugar Boba to strike, dealing AoE <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> once and entering Grain Market for 7s. During this time, the first Grain Settlement DMG is guaranteed to Crit.
Converts all remaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">Grain Loans</> into <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> and enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes2">Surplus</> state after casting Zero-Sum Game. Invests all Grains into the Grain Market. Afterward, press Pink Paws Priority Principle to gain Grains based on current <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes5">Grain Price</> fluctuations during <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes6">Grain Settlement</>. Hold Pink Paws Priority Principle to trigger Grain Settlement once based on the Grain Price on first activation.
Leaves the Grain Market and prioritizes repaying Grain Loans with all available Grains when Grain Market duration ends.
Grants access to the Grain Market while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes3">Debt</> state and holding any Grain Loans.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
造成<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，并进入「金谷市场」，持续7秒，期间第1次「谷价结算」的伤害必定暴击。立刻获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">「金谷贷款」</>。

点按变轨技能，根据按下时的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes5">「金谷K线」</>值，结算当前金谷数量，并在变轨技能进入下一段后，可再次点按变轨技能进行<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes6">「谷价结算」</>。

长按变轨技能，根据按下时的金谷K线值，结算当前金谷数量，并在变轨技能进入下一段时，不进行谷价结算。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Deals <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and enters the Grain Market for 7s. During this time, the first Grain Settlement DMG is guaranteed to Crit. Immediately grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">Grain Loan</>.

Press Redirect Skill to settle the current Grain amount based on the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes5">Grain Price</> on first activation. Triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes6">Grain Settlement</> when starting the next Redirect Skill 

Hold Redirect Skill to settle the current Grain amount based on the Grain Price on first activation. Grain Settlement will not be triggered when starting the next Redirect Skill.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>困于漂亮花园中的少女，她只是洞穴中的囚徒。直到她拥有了万花筒般得以洞察一切的眼睛，她才摸索着壁沿，踉踉跄跄地来到新世界。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>A girl trapped in a beautiful garden was no more than a prisoner in a cave. Only after gaining kaleidoscope eyes that could see through all things did she feel her way along the walls and stumble into a new world.</>

Description.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔释放「极轨终结：见此终幕」对目标造成范围性<An>暗属性异能伤害</>，并解放左眼。在此期间自身造成的伤害提高，并为范围内敌人植入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">「洞察」</>。达芙蒂尔新增技能<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">「幻影移行」</>，累计使用2次，释放「极轨终结：见此终幕」可刷新次数。
Description.LocalizedString: Casts Finale, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</> to enemies in an area. Unseals her left eye, increasing damage and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> on nearby enemies for the duration. Unlocks the skill <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</>, which can be used up to 2 times. Casting Finale resets Phantom Step charges.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<An>暗属性异能伤害</>并解放左眼。在此期间自身造成的伤害提高，并为范围内敌人植入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">「洞察」</>，同时达芙蒂尔新增技能<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">「幻影移行」</>，累计使用2次，释放「极轨终结：见此终幕」可刷新次数。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</> and unseals the left eye, increasing damage and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> on nearby enemies for the duration. Unlocks the skill <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</>, which can be used up to 2 times. Casting Finale resets Phantom Step charges.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>「我已经失去了一切。请问是要我为了什么而干杯呢？」</>
<Italic>「干杯也需要理由吗？嗯……那就……敬一无所有的绝境，敬未曾目睹的天色。再敬这湖心独一无二的水仙。」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>"I have lost everything. What exactly am I supposed to toast to?"</>
<Italic>"Do you need a reason to toast? Well… then let's toast to absolute despair, to skies we've never seen, and to the one and only narcissus blooming in the heart of this lake."</>

Desc.SourceString: 承轨反击额外伤害倍率

Description.SourceString: 接下来的事交给我。达芙蒂尔挥斩刀刃，对目标造成1次<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Leave the rest to me. Swings her blade in a slashing motion, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to the target.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<An>暗属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <An>Chaos DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>伊波恩古董店的保镖小姐向来很可靠。那格外干净利索的身手让人确信——只要相信她，一切都可以迎刃而解。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>The bodyguard at Eibon Antique Shop has always been reliable. Her clean, efficient skills inspire confidence that, as long as she‘s trusted, any problem can be solved with ease.</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「失谐」强化</>：当目标进入「失谐」状态时，额外削减其10%倾陷值上限，持续30秒。当目标脱离战斗时，其倾陷值上限将恢复原状。多次触发「失谐」强化，削减效果可叠加，最高削减量为目标初始倾陷值上限的20%。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>「失谐」强化</>：当目标进入「失谐」状态时，额外削减其10%倾陷值上限，持续30秒。当目标脱离战斗时，其倾陷值上限将恢复原状。多次触发「失谐」强化，削减效果可叠加，最高削减量为目标初始倾陷值上限的20%。

ShortDescription.SourceString: <TextHLT>「失谐」强化</>：当目标进入「失谐」状态时，额外削减其10%倾陷值上限，持续30秒。当目标脱离战斗时，其倾陷值上限将恢复原状。多次触发「失谐」强化，削减效果可叠加，最高削减量为目标初始倾陷值上限的20%。

Description.SourceString: <Italic>面无表情的外表下，或许也有晴光映雪般一闪而过的柔软。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Beneath her expressionless façade, fleeting moments of tenderness may appear, like sunlight dancing on snow.</>

Description.SourceString: <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">「幻影移行」</>造成的伤害提升80%。
Description.LocalizedString: Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</> DMG by 80%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">「幻影移行」</>造成的伤害提升80%。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</> DMG by 80%.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>她曾机械般游走于灰色边境，但现在，至少她有归所。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>She once wandered the gray borderlands like a machine, but now she has somewhere to call home.</>

Description.SourceString: 哈尼娅抬手发射魔法弹，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Fires magic projectiles and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 哈尼娅在普攻第一段时长按普攻键可转身进入蓄力状态，并向前发射<NumGreen>1</>枚蓄力炮。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during the 1st hit to charge, then fire <NumGreen>a</> charged cannon forward.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，最多可弹射<NumGreen>4</>次。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and ricochets up to <NumGreen>4</> times.

Description.SourceString: 哈尼娅滞空时点按普攻，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后，使用「普通攻击：盖罗塞克特术法」发动。这么慢的话会被顾客投诉的哦？哈尼娅闪身躲过攻击，并立即向敌人发射一枚飞弹，造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Genesse Technique after a Critical Dodge. Being this slow will get us customer complaints, you know? Dodges the attack and fires a missile, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</>, and reducing Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>魔术与魔法的区别在于，只要你相信魔法，它就存在……比如空手搓球？</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>The difference between magic tricks and real magic? As long as you believe, it exists… Like conjuring orbs with your bare hands?</>

Description.SourceString:
沉谧深林的月下之鸮啊，响应我的召唤！哈尼娅掷出便携式音箱「咕咕子」并造成范围性<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
「咕咕子」在场时，全队角色获得基于哈尼娅基础攻击力的攻击力加成。
场上角色攻击时，会为「咕咕子」累积<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielSkill">「四部和声」</>，每<NumGreen>0.5</>秒至多累积<NumGreen>1</>层。累积<NumGreen>4</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielSkill">「四部和声」</>后将触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">「合奏」</>，对「咕咕子」周围的敌人造成范围性<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
场上至多存在<NumGreen>1</>个「咕咕子」音箱，重复释放将刷新「咕咕子」的持续时间。切换角色时，「咕咕子」会留在场上。
Description.LocalizedString:
"O owl of the quiet, moonlit forest depths, answer my call!" Throws her portable speaker Hootie, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area.
Grants the Team an ATK bonus based on Haniel's Base ATK while Hootie is active.
Grants Hootie <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielSkill">Four-Part Harmony</> when the current character attacks, up to <NumGreen>1</> stack every <NumGreen>0.5s</>. Accumulating <NumGreen>4</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielSkill">Four-Part Harmony</> triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to enemies in an area around Hootie.
Only <NumGreen>1</> Hootie can exist at a time. Casting again refreshes Hootie's duration. Hootie remains when switching characters.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 释放「咕咕子」，留在场上提供增益效果，且伴随攻击造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deploys Hootie to remain on the field and provide buffs, while dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</> with attacks.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「沉谧深林的月下之鸮啊，我以哈尼娅之名，与你签订契约！……咕咕子，配合一下嘛。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>O owl of the quiet, moonlit forest depths, I, Haniel, hereby forge a contract with you! …Come on, Hootie, work with me here.</>

Description.SourceString: 别那么无趣嘛，来点彩蛋如何？哈尼娅向敌人掷出<NumGreen>1</>枚魔法弹，造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Don't be so boring! How about a little easter egg? Fires <NumGreen>1</> magic projectile at the enemy, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
盖罗塞克特女子学院超异科已接管现场！哈尼娅释放以自身为中心的强化领域，进入「超异科王牌」状态，持续一段时间。
全队角色获得基于哈尼娅基础攻击力的攻击力加成。
触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">「合奏」</>时，同时以角色自身为中心，额外触发1次范围更大伤害更高的「合奏·交响」。「合奏·交响」无法为哈尼娅叠加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">「主角光环」</>层数。触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">「合奏」</>时，当前在场角色的下次攻击将附带额外伤害，持续<NumGreen>3</>秒，该效果不可叠加。
「超异科王牌」状态存在期间，「咕咕子」的持续时间停止计时，直至哈尼娅退出「超异科王牌」状态后，恢复计时。
Description.LocalizedString:
Genesse Girls' Academy Paranormal Department! Assuming control! Releases an enhancement field centered on herself and gaining the Paranormal Ace effect for a period of time.
Grants the Team an ATK bonus based on Haniel's Base ATK.
Triggering <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</> simultaneously triggers 1 additional Ensemble - Symphony effect around the character with increased DMG and range. Ensemble - Symphony does not grant <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> for Haniel. When triggering <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, the current active character's next attack deals additional damage for <NumGreen>3s</>. Effect does not stack.
While Paranormal Ace is active, Hootie's duration timer is paused until the end of the effect.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 哈尼娅进入「超异科王牌」状态，强化「咕咕子」效果，并且强化自身的能力。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Haniel enters Paranormal Ace state, enhancing Hootie's effects and boosting her own abilities.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>海特洛市的地图上可找不到盖罗塞克特女子学院，当然也找不到超异科，这个故事要从哈尼娅的第一本连载小说说起……</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>You won't find Genesse Girls' Academy on any map of Hethereau, and naturally you won't find the Paranormal Department either. This story begins with Haniel's first serialized novel…</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「黯星」强化</>：「黯星」状态结束时，全队角色从目标汲取攻击力。目标损失相当于哈尼娅4%基础攻击力的攻击力，全队角色获得哈尼娅8%基础攻击力。累计汲取不超过哈尼娅16%基础攻击力，目标损失不超过20%初始攻击力。离开战斗状态时还原双方属性。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Allows all allies to drain ATK from the target when Nova ends. The target loses ATK equal to 4% of Haniel's Base ATK, and each ally gains ATK equal to 8% of Haniel's Base ATK. The total drain is capped at 16% of Haniel's Base ATK, and the target cannot lose more than 20% of their initial ATK. Restores both parties' stats upon exiting combat.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>对于哈尼娅来说，比起那些孤独的英雄主义小说，她还是更喜欢热热闹闹的伙伴故事，就算是一群热血笨蛋也不错。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>For Haniel, she'd rather hear lively stories about companions than lonely tales of heroism. Even a bunch of hot-headed fools would be fine.</>

Description.SourceString:
当在场角色触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">「合奏」</>时，可以为哈尼娅累积<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">「主角光环」</>，用以提高「超异科魔法炮」的弹射次数。每触发<NumGreen>1</>次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">「合奏」</>使得哈尼娅获得<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">「主角光环」</>。
当哈尼娅处于「超异科王牌」状态时，每触发<NumGreen>1</>次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">「合奏」</>使得哈尼娅获得<NumGreen>2</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">「主角光环」</>。
通过这种方式至多累积<NumGreen>4</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">「主角光环」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Grants Haniel <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> when the current character triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, increasing the ricochet cap of Paranormal Cannon. Grants <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> <NumGreen>per</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</> trigger.
Grants <NumGreen>2</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> <NumGreen>per</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</> trigger while Haniel is in Paranormal Ace state.
Can accumulate up to <NumGreen>4</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>看热血运动番想学运动，看热血乐队番想学乐器，看热血战斗番想……这个还是不建议学习了。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Sports anime makes you want to play sports. Band anime makes you want to learn an instrument. Battle anime… well, I wouldn't recommend trying that.</>

Description.SourceString: 伊洛伊召唤小羊们，进行至多五段的连续攻击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。攻击命中时积攒<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">「臆想」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Summons lambs to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> when attacks hit.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成灵属性异能伤害，命中积攒「臆想」。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals Anima DMG. Builds up Imagination on hit.

Description.SourceString:
长按普通攻击，伊洛伊消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">「臆想」</>进行蓄力，根据蓄力程度，发动至多三段的「普通攻击：白日梦」，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
「无意识响应」、「援护技：砰！」、「变轨技能：未来自我连续性假设」、「极轨终结：三十八亿年的海市蜃楼」期间长按普通攻击，伊洛伊消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">「臆想」</>可直接发动第三段的「普通攻击：白日梦」，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Hold Basic Attack to charge up, consuming <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> based on the charge duration to unleash up to 3 instances of Daydream, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Hold Basic Attack during Reflexive Response, Bang!, Future Self Continuity, and 3.8-Billion-Year Mirage, consuming <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> to unleash the 3rd instance of Daydream, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
长按蓄力消耗「臆想」发动至多三段的攻击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
「无意识响应」、「援护技」、「变轨技能」、「极轨终结」期间长按蓄力消耗「臆想」发动第三段攻击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Hold to charge up, consuming Imagination to launch up to 3 instances of attack, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Hold to charge up during Reflexive Response, Support Skill, Redirect Skill, and Ultimate, consuming Imagination to unleash the 3rd attack, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 在伊洛伊发动「普通攻击：白日梦」后，再次长按普攻，消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">「臆想」</>，召唤莫尔甫斯发动长时间的连续射击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack again after Iroi uses Basic Attack: Daydream to consume <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>, summoning Morpheus to unleash sustained fire that deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 「普通攻击：白日梦」后再次长按普攻，消耗「臆想」造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack again after using Daydream to consume Imagination and deal <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 伊洛伊滞空时点按普攻，落地后造成1次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。攻击命中时积攒<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">「臆想」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height by up to 100%. Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> on hit.

被动

Name.SourceString: 三十八亿年的海市蜃楼

Description.SourceString:
回到最初的梦境中去吧。伊洛伊开启梦境的大门，根据<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">「臆想」</>积攒程度，发动不同效果。
若「臆想」未积攒到阈值：伊洛伊开启牛角门的梦境，梦境期间提供持续全体治疗。
若「臆想」已积攒到阈值：伊洛伊开启象牙门的梦境，梦境期间提供持续全体治疗，并对身处其中的敌人持续造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。在此期间长按<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">「退行」</>状态角色头像，则在梦境期间暂时复活该角色并回复一定生命值（期间最多只能复活1名角色）。
梦境期间持续消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">「臆想」</>，消耗完毕后梦境结束，被复活的角色将回到<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">「退行」</>状态。
梦境期间无法积攒<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">「臆想」</>，但在此期间使用「普通攻击：白日梦」「普通攻击：清明梦」将不消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">「臆想」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Return to the first dream. Opens the gate to a dream and triggers different effects based on the amount of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> built up.
If Imagination has not reached the required threshold: Iroi opens the Dream of the Horned Gate, continuously healing all allies.
If Imagination has reached the required threshold: Iroi opens the Dream of the Ivory Gate, continuously healing all allies and dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemies inside the dream. During this time, press and hold the avatar of a team member in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state to temporarily revive them and restore a portion of their HP. This effect can revive up to 1 character during each dream.
The dream continuously consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>. When Imagination is depleted, the dream ends, and the revived character returns to the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state.
While the dream is active, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> cannot be built up, but casting Daydream and Lucid Dream do not consume <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
开启梦境，根据「臆想」积攒程度发动不同效果。
未达积攒阈值：提供持续全体治疗。
达到积攒阈值：对敌人持续造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。在此期间如切换至「退行」角色，则复活该角色并回复一定生命值。
梦境在「臆想」消耗完毕后结束，结束后被复活角色回到「退行」状态。
梦境期间无法积攒「臆想」，但在此期间使用「普通攻击：白日梦」「普通攻击：清明梦」将不消耗「臆想」。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Opens a dream and triggers different effects based on the amount of Imagination built up.
Below threshold: Continuously heals all allies.
At threshold: Deals continuous <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Switching to a character in Regression state during the dream revives that character and restores some portion of their HP.
The dream ends when Imagination is depleted. The revived character then returns to Regression.
While the dream is active, Imagination cannot be built up, but casting Daydream and Lucid Dream do not consume Imagination.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>我在梦境的最初与最后分别听到两声钟响，但钟声只会响起一次。从深海的热液到地上的高楼，恼人的钟声一直都在。天啊，那钟声足足响了三十八亿年！</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>I heard the bell at both ends of the dream: once at the beginning, once at the end. But the bell only rang once. From hydrothermal vents in the deep sea to skyscrapers on land, that awful chime has followed everything. Oh my, it's been ringing for 3.8 billion years.</>

Desc.LocalizedString: Within the Dream: Imagination Cost Per Second

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「创生」强化</>：当前创生株生成3秒后，将额外生成1株「创生株复制体」。复制体消失后不会再次生成复制体，且不计入创生株数量上限。复制体共绽放20朵「复制创生花」；每隔0.5秒，「复制创生花」会飞向射程内的目标并爆炸，每朵造成原「创生花」37.5%的伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Generates a Vita Bud Copy when the current Vita Bud has existed for 3s. This copy cannot duplicate and does not count toward the Vita Bud limit. The copy produces 20 Copied Vita Pistils. Every 0.5s, one Copied Vita Pistil flies toward a target within range and explodes, dealing 37.5% of the original Vita Pistil's DMG.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>有时候，我的影子比我更先一步到达目的地。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Sometimes, my shadow gets there before I do.</>

Description.SourceString: 伊洛伊在提供治疗时，额外为全队提供5%的无视防御的效果，持续20秒。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants all team members an additional 5% DEF Ignore for 20s when performing healing.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>我的躯体总是忠实地活着。它伤痕累累，一言不发。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>My body lives on faithfully, covered in scars and never saying a word.</>

Description.LocalizedString: Interacts with small animals in the open world to obtain a random growth item, up to 3 times per day and 999 times in total.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>要走哪条路？</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Which path should I follow?</>

Description.SourceString: 要唱得流畅而自然！海月挥动指挥棒，进行至多4段的连续攻击，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Sing smoothly and naturally! Wields her weapon and performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals<Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
要唱得响亮而饱满！移动时长按闪避，海月可乘坐水母，持续高速移动。周围存在目标时，每隔一段时间生成水母弹，攻击范围内的随机目标，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
在此状态下，海月会使用特殊闪避动作，「极限闪避反击：切分节奏」变为自动发射四枚水母弹。
剩余一定耐力值后，自动退出该状态。
Description.LocalizedString:
Sing loudly and fully! Hold Dodge while moving to ride a jellyfish, sprinting at high speed for the duration. Generates a jellyfish blast at intervals when targets are nearby, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
Performs a special Dodge in this state, and "Critical Dodge Riposte: Syncopation" automatically fires four jellyfish blasts.
Ends automatically when stamina drops below a certain amount.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
移动时长按闪避，进入特殊状态。每隔一段时间生成水母弹，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
在此状态下，「极限闪避反击：切分节奏」变为发射水母弹。
剩余一定耐力值后，自动退出该状态。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Hold Dodge while moving to enter a special state. Generates a jellyfish blast at intervals, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
Performs a special Dodge in this state, and Syncopation automatically fires four jellyfish blasts.
Ends automatically when stamina drops low.

Description.SourceString: 要唱得清越而优美！海月在空中挥动指挥棒，并迅速下落冲击地面，落地时造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Sing clearly and beautifully! Wields the weapon mid-air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals<Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
触发极限闪避后，释放「普通攻击：连音」触发。
不如来试试我的节奏吧？海月挥动指挥棒，造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString:
Triggers when casting Legato after a Critical Dodge.
Think you can handle my rhythm? Wields her weapon to deal <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area and reduces Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals<Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>声乐也是指挥不可或缺的素养，要勤加练习。腹部发力，牙关打开，感受声音穿过后脑、从眉心位置发出来……是这里吗？</>
<Italic>「啊——啊——」</>
<Italic>……怎么感觉歌声好像也在迷路。</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>Vocal technique is key for any conductor, so I keep practicing. Engage the core, relax the jaw, let the sound flow from the back of my head and out through my brow…</>
<Italic>"Ah—ah—"</>
<Italic>…Why does it feel like even my own voice is slipping away?</>

Description.SourceString: 将随处可见的日常谱成虹色的旋律，让它们响彻天际吧。造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>并进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">「华彩」</>状态，持续<NumGreen>12</>秒。
Description.LocalizedString: Transform the everyday into a rainbow melody and let it roar across the skyline. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state for <NumGreen>12</>s.

ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>如果没有加入玉饼街居民协会，海月说不定会去华彩街做管理员。或许冥冥之中，一切自有缘分。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>If she hadn't joined the Tamamochi Street Resident Association, Aurelia might have ended up as an administrator on Cadenza Street instead. In the end, perhaps it's all just a matter of fate.</>

Description.SourceString: 优秀的指挥可从不会误判时机！海月指挥水母发动突袭，在命中目标时造成1次范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: True command means never mistaking the timing. Commands the jellyfish to strike, dealing 1 instance of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> on hit.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals<Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 接下来的唱段，就让我们一同完成吧。海月将水母群聚拢至身边，造成6段范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，并小幅聚集敌人。
Description.LocalizedString: Let's play the next verse together. Gathers nearby jellyfish, dealing 6 instances of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and slightly pulling targets together.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，聚集敌人。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and pulls enemies together.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>无论是学生时代的合唱团，还是那支昙花一现的乐队，都是海月最珍贵的宝物。辉煌的乐章若是只有一人独奏，实在有些太寂寞了。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Whether it was the school choir or that short-lived, chaotic band, these were Aurelia's most cherished memories. Even a brilliant solo would feel far too lonely.</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「黯星」强化</>：目标的「黯星」状态结束后，将受到3次来自海月50%攻击力的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Deals 3 instances of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to the target after their Nova status ends, each equal to 50% of ATK.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>要怎么证明声音是一种波呢？向水里丢一枚石子，涟漪便会一圈圈漾开；向人丢一枚石子，同样也能听到连绵不绝的声音。</>
<Italic>「……这里该笑吗？」</>
<Italic>「海月姐的玩笑，一点也不好笑——」</>
<Italic>「怎么这样！以前她们可都很捧场的……是你们这些小家伙笑点太高了吧。」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>How do you prove that sound is a wave? Toss a stone into water and see the ripples spread; toss a stone at someone, and you’ll hear wave after wave of noise.</>
<Italic>"…Am I supposed to laugh?"</>
<Italic>"Aurelia's jokes aren't funny at all—"</>
<Italic>"No way! People used to eat that up… you kids just have your humor standards way too high."</>

Description.SourceString: 每当水母弹命中目标时，海月的攻击力提升<NumGreen>1%</>，效果持续<NumGreen>5</>秒，最多可叠加<NumGreen>10</>层。
Description.LocalizedString: Increases Aurelia's ATK by <NumGreen>1%</> for <NumGreen>5</>s when a jellyfish blast hits a target, up to <NumGreen>10</> stacks.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>强、中强、很强、最强音！还要更强吗？那只好请鼓手一头扎进鼓里了。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Strong… stronger… Super Sound… Ultimate Sound! Want it even louder? Then the drummer will just have to throw themselves into the drum headfirst!</>

Description.SourceString: 海月乘坐水母，穿行于城市的大街小巷。海月无法攀爬或跨越障碍物，但跳跃高度有所提升，且具备特殊的滑翔和游泳能力。
Description.LocalizedString: Aurelia rides a jellyfish, gliding effortlessly through the city's streets and alleys. She can't climb or vault over obstacles, but her jump is higher, and she gains special gliding and swimming abilities.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>无法迈出脚步，不代表无法继续向前。心就如同世界本身那样自由而广阔，只要愿意出发，无论何处都能抵达。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Being unable to take a single step doesn't mean you can't keep moving forward. Let your heart be as free and boundless as the world—once you set out, there's nowhere you can't reach.</>

Description.LocalizedString: Performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</> on hit.

Description.SourceString: 别想有喘息的机会。真红疾速冲向目标，发起一轮迅猛的攻势，造成多段<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>并获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">「桀骜斗志」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: No time to catch your breath. Charges toward the target and launches a fierce assault, dealing multiple instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 真红疾速冲向目标造成多段<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>并获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">「桀骜斗志」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Charges toward the target, dealing multiple instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</>.

Description.SourceString: 消耗所有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">「清醒边缘」</>，真红跃向目标上方的视野盲区，向下释放威力强大的爪击，对目标造成高额<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。每次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>持续期间最多释放<NumGreen>5</>次。
Description.LocalizedString: Consumes all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">Fading Reason</>. Leaps above the target into their blind spot and unleashes a powerful downward claw strike, dealing high <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Casts up to <NumGreen>5</> times during each <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> state.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 消耗所有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">「清醒边缘」</>，真红跃释放爪击对目标造成高额<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。每次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>持续期间最多释放<NumGreen>5</>次。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Consumes all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">Fading Reason</>. Leaps and unleashes a claw strike, dealing high <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Casts up to <NumGreen>5</> times during each <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> state.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「速战速决，这样就不会让事情发展到最坏。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Let's end this quickly, before this gets any worse."</>

Desc.SourceString: 「变轨技能：天降赤锋」一段伤害倍率
Desc.LocalizedString: Redirect Skill: Scarlet Descent 1st Instance DMG Ratio
Redirect Skill: High-Speed Breach Cycle Energy

Description.SourceString:
别以为做了这种事之后还能全身而退……真红消耗所有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">「桀骜斗志」</>进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>状态，随后发起多段攻击，对目标造成高额<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
「升腾之赤」：「普通攻击：特种格斗术」替换为「普通攻击：惊骇急袭」，「变轨技能：高速突破」替换为「变轨技能：天降赤锋」，造成的伤害和抗打断能力提升，移动能力大幅提升，持续<NumGreen>13</>秒，切换角色后退出<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>。
真红在移动中长按闪避可部分解放异能，大幅提高移动能力。
Description.LocalizedString:
Don't think you can pull something like that and escape unscathed… Consumes all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</> to enter the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> state, then launches multiple attacks, dealing high <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the target.
Replaces Special Combat Arts with Tidal Assault and High-Speed Breach with Scarlet Descent while in Surging Crimson state. Increases DMG dealt and Resistance to Interruptions, greatly boosts Movement, and lasts for <NumGreen>13</>s. Ends <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> when switching characters.
Hold Dodge while moving to partially release her Esper Ability and greatly boost Movement.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
真红消耗所有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">「桀骜斗志」</>进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>状态并发起多段攻击，对目标造成高额<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
「升腾之赤」：「普通攻击：特种格斗术」替换为「普通攻击：惊骇急袭」，「变轨技能：高速突破」替换为「变轨技能：天降赤锋」，造成的伤害和抗打断能力提升，移动能力提升，持续<NumGreen>13</>秒，切换角色后退出<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>。
真红在移动中长按闪避可部分解放异能，大幅提高移动能力。

Consumes all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</> to enter the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> state and unleash multiple attacks, dealing high <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the target.
Replaces Special Combat Arts with Tidal Assault and High-Speed Breach with Scarlet Descent while in Surging Crimson state. Increases DMG dealt and Resistance to Interruptions, boosts Movement, and lasts for <NumGreen>13</>s. Ends <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> when switching characters.
Hold Dodge while moving to partially release her Esper Ability and greatly boost Movement.

Description.SourceString:
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>即将结束时，真红可释放「极轨终结：赤红的处决」，连续点按「极轨终结」以在目标之间高速位移穿梭，造成高额<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>持续期间，真红每释放过<NumGreen>1</>次「变轨技能：天降赤锋」，即可额外释放<NumGreen>1</>段「极轨终结：赤红的处决」，每次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>持续期间最多释放<NumGreen>3</>次。
Description.LocalizedString:
Casts Crimson Judgment when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> is about to end. Press Ultimate repeatedly to dash rapidly between targets, dealing high <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
Grants <NumGreen>1</> additional instance of Crimson Judgment for <NumGreen>each</> use of Scarlet Descent during <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</>. Can be cast up to <NumGreen>3</> times during each <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> state.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>即将结束时可释放「极轨终结：赤红的处决」，连续点按「极轨终结」高速穿梭，造成高额<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>持续期间，每释放过<NumGreen>1</>次「变轨技能：天降赤锋」，即可额外释放<NumGreen>1</>段「极轨终结：赤红的处决」，每次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>持续期间最多释放<NumGreen>3</>次。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Casts Crimson Judgment when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> is about to end. Press Ultimate repeatedly to dash rapidly between targets, dealing high <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
Grants <NumGreen>1</> additional instance of Crimson Judgment for <NumGreen>each</> use of Scarlet Descent during <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</>. Description.SourceString: 当所有「极轨终结：赤红的处决」次数均被使用或<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>持续时间结束后，再次点按「极轨终结」释放「极轨终结：处决的龙炎」，对大范围目标造成高额<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Press Ultimate again to cast Dragonflame Verdict after all uses of Crimson Judgment have been consumed or after <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> ends, dealing massive <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to targets in a large area.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 当所有「极轨终结：赤红的处决」次数均被使用或<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">「升腾之赤」</>持续时间结束后，再次点按「极轨终结」释放「极轨终结：处决的龙炎」，对大范围目标造成高额<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Press Ultimate again to cast Dragonflame Verdict after all uses of Crimson Judgment have been consumed or after <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> ends, dealing massive <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to targets in a large area.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「会很疼的。对她的敌人如此，对她亦如是。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"It will hurt—for her enemies, and for her as well."</>

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「会很疼的。对她的敌人如此，对她亦如是。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"It will hurt—for her enemies, and for her as well."</>

「极轨终结：处决的龙炎」伤害倍率
「极轨终结：赤红的处决」每段伤害倍率

Description.SourceString: 闹够了没有！真红奋力膝击，造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，并获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">「桀骜斗志」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Enough already! Delivers a forceful knee strike, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 真红奋力膝击造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Guang>光属性异能伤害</>，并获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">「桀骜斗志」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Delivers a forceful knee strike, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「对于习惯单打独斗的少女来说，与人合作是一大进步。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"For a girl long used to fighting alone, learning to stand beside others marks a major step forward."</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「盈蓄」强化</>：当场上角色获得终结能量时，后台角色将获得等量充能。真红位于前台且处于盈蓄期间时，每次触发都会造成 400%*攻击力 的范围伤害（倍率跟随普通攻击技能等级成长，11级成长至<NumGreen>863.6%</>），并使自身攻击力提升 5%，持续 30 秒，最多叠加 10 层。此效果有1秒冷却。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Grants off-field characters the same amount of Charge when the active character gains Ultimate Energy. While Shinku is active and in Charge state, each trigger deals AoE DMG equal to 400% of ATK (scales with Basic Attack level, reaching <NumGreen>863.6%</> at level 11), and increases her ATK by 5% for 30s, up to 10 stacks. Cooldown: 1s.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「对于现在的真红来说，多数情况还不至于将她逼到不得不全力以赴。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"For Shinku as she is now, few situations are enough to make her go all out."</>

Description.SourceString: 真红的「极轨终结」对非Boss目标造成的伤害提升<NumGreen>50%</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Increases Ultimate DMG against non-Boss enemies by <NumGreen>50%</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「——除非，她的伙伴陷入了险境。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"—Unless her friends are in peril."</>

Description.SourceString:
当真红在场上超过2秒未主动发动攻击时进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">「威慑凝视」</>状态，每秒叠加层数。状态期间，真红每次成功发动极限闪避额外获得<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">「威慑凝视」</>。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">「威慑凝视」</>层数上限为<NumGreen>8</>，切换角色移除状态和层数。
真红主动发动攻击命中时解除<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">「威慑凝视」</>状态，进行「即瞬猛袭」，在原本的攻击之外附带额外伤害。每有一层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">「威慑凝视」</>，额外伤害增加<NumGreen>100%</>（倍率跟随普通攻击技能等级成长，11级成长至<NumGreen>215.9%</>），伴随获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">「桀骜斗志」</>、<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">「清醒边缘」</>及环合值。
Description.LocalizedString:
Enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> state when Shinku remains active in battle for more than 2s without actively initiating an attack, gaining stacks every second. Grants her <NumGreen>1</> additional stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> whenever Shinku successfully performs a Critical Dodge while this state is active.
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> stacks up to <NumGreen>8</> times. Switching characters removes the state and all stacks.
Ends <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> when Shinku initiates an attack and hits, causing her to perform Instant Strike and deal bonus DMG in addition to the original attack. Each stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> increases this bonus DMG by <NumGreen>100%</> (scales with Basic Attack level, reaching <NumGreen>215.9%</> at level 11) and grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</>, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">Fading Reason</>, and Cycle Energy.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「冷静思考，真红，不要让本能占据了你的大脑。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Stay calm, Shinku. Don't let your instincts take over."</>

Description.SourceString: 现实形态下，残虹挥动妖刀进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，其中普攻第5段可以吸附范围内的敌人。期间残虹拥有增益效果<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">「狩」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Wields her blade and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks while in Reality Form, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Pulls in targets within range on the 5th instance of Basic Attack. Gains the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> buff for the attack's duration.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 现实形态下进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段连续攻击，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，其中普攻第5段可以吸附范围内的敌人。拥有增益效果<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">「狩」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks while in Reality Form, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> and pulling in targets within range on the 5th attack. Gains the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> buff.

Description.SourceString: 幻境形态下，残虹驱动妖刀和缎带进行至多<NumGreen>4</>段的连续攻击，攻击命中时对目标施加<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">「蚀心」</>，并造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，其中普攻第3段可以吸附范围内的敌人。每段「普通攻击：魇舞」释放时，残虹能将目标身上最多<NumGreen>4</>种持续伤害效果扩散至一定范围内的目标，包括原目标。期间残虹拥有增益效果<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">「惑」</>。此外，「普通攻击：魇舞」造成的伤害视为追加攻击。
Description.LocalizedString: Wields her blade to pull the silk and performs up to <NumGreen>4</> consecutive attacks while in Illusion Form, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> and inflicting <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on hit. Pulls in targets within range on the 3rd instance of Basic Attack. Each Nightmare Waltz attack spreads up to <NumGreen>4</> DoT effects from the target to all enemies in the area, including the original target. Gains the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> buff for the attack's duration. The DMG dealt by Nightmare Waltz counts as Follow-up Attack DMG.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 幻境形态下进行至多<NumGreen>4</>段连续攻击，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，其中普攻第3段可以吸附范围内的敌人。命中时对目标施加<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">「蚀心」</>，每段攻击释放时，残虹能将目标身上的持续伤害扩散至一定范围内的目标，包括原目标。拥有增益效果<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">「惑」</>。此外，「普通攻击：魇舞」造成的伤害视为追加攻击。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Performs up to <NumGreen>4</> consecutive attacks while in Illusion Form, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Pulls in targets within range on the 3rd instance of Basic Attack. Inflicts <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on hit. Each attack spreads the target's DoT effects to all enemies in the area, including the original target. Gains the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> buff. The DMG dealt by Nightmare Waltz counts as Follow-up Attack DMG.

Description.SourceString: 残虹在现实形态下，「普通攻击：燎原」第<NumGreen>1</>/<NumGreen>2</>段中，长按普通攻击触发「普通攻击：绰影」，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during the <NumGreen>1st</> or <NumGreen>2nd</> stage of Wildfire while in Reality Form to trigger Flickering Shadow, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 现实形态下，普攻第<NumGreen>1</>/<NumGreen>2</>段中长按普攻，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during the <NumGreen>1st</> or <NumGreen>2nd</> stage of a Basic Attack while in Reality Form to deal <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 残虹在幻境形态下，「普通攻击：魇舞」第<NumGreen>1</>/<NumGreen>2</>段中，长按普通攻击触发「普通攻击：落月」，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。命中时对目标施加<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">「蚀心」</>。「普通攻击：落月」造成的伤害视为追加攻击。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during the <NumGreen>1st</> or <NumGreen>2nd</> stage of Nightmare Waltz while in Illusion Form to trigger Moonfall, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Inflicts <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on hit. The DMG dealt by Moonfall counts as Follow-up Attack DMG.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 幻境形态下，普攻第<NumGreen>1</>/<NumGreen>2</>段中长按普攻，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。命中时对目标施加<NumGreen>1</>层<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">「蚀心」</>。「普通攻击：落月」造成的伤害视为追加攻击。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during the <NumGreen>1st</> or <NumGreen>2nd</> stage of a Basic Attack while in Illusion Form to deal <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Inflicts <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on hit. The DMG dealt by Moonfall counts as Follow-up Attack DMG.

Description.SourceString: 残虹滞空时点按普通攻击，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> in an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height by up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 滞空时点按普攻，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后点击普通攻击触发，造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>，并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack after a Critical Dodge to deal <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> and reduce Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Zhou>咒属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>梦魇翩然而至，绝望如火焚身。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>The nightmare drifts in, and despair burns from within.</>

Description.SourceString: 残虹在现实形态下，成功释放「变轨技能：绯影闪」后切换为幻境形态。在释放「普通攻击：燎原」<NumGreen>4</>/<NumGreen>5</>段、「普通攻击：绰影」、「极限反击：虚徊」后一定时间内，可释放强化「变轨技能：绯影闪」，对命中的目标施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">「蚀心」</>，并触发<TextHLT>「乱」</>：扣除大范围目标高额倾陷值。释放「变轨技能：绯影闪」切换为幻境形态时，现实形态的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">「狩」</>延迟清除。技能在完成形态切换前被打断时，形态不会改变。
Description.LocalizedString: Switches to Illusion Form after successfully casting Sanguine Dash while in Reality Form. Enables an enhanced Sanguine Dash for a set time after the <NumGreen>4th</> or <NumGreen>5th</> stage of Wildfire, Flickering Shadow, or Voidstep. Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on targets hit and triggers <TextHLT>Disarray</>, reducing massive Break of enemies in a large area. Delays the removal of the Reality Form <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> effect when switching to Illusion Form with Sanguine Dash. Prevents the form switch if the skill is interrupted before it is complete.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 现实形态下成功释放变轨技能后切换为幻境形态，同时<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">「狩」</>延迟清除。在现实形态下特定攻击后释放强化变轨技能，可对命中的目标施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">「蚀心」</>，并触发<TextHLT>「乱」</>：扣除大范围目标高额倾陷值。技能在完成形态切换前被打断时，形态不会改变。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Switches to Illusion Form after successfully casting Redirect Skill while in Reality Form. Delays the removal of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</>. Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on targets hit and triggers <TextHLT>Disarray</> when casting an enhanced Redirect Skill after certain attacks while in Reality Form, reducing massive Break of enemies in a large area. Prevents the form switch if the skill is interrupted before it is complete.

Description.SourceString:
残虹在幻境形态下，成功释放「变轨技能：离魂错」后切换为现实形态。幻境状态即将结束时，可释放强化「变轨技能：离魂错」对大范围目标造成高额伤害，对命中的目标施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">「蚀心」</>，并触发<TextHLT>「灭」</>：激活「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」。
幻境状态持续一段时间；成功释放「变轨技能：离魂错」或「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」、持续时间结束或残虹离场时，幻境状态解除，残虹回到现实形态。释放「变轨技能：离魂错」切换为现实形态时，幻境形态的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">「惑」</>延迟清除。「变轨技能：离魂错」及其强化版本造成的伤害均视为追加攻击。技能在完成形态切换前被打断时，形态不会改变。
Description.LocalizedString:
Switches to Reality Form after successfully casting Soulcross while in Illusion Form. Enables an enhanced Soulcross shortly before Illusion Form ends. Deals massive DMG to enemies in a large area, inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on targets hit, and triggers <TextHLT>Oblivion</>, activating Bloodfeast Reverie.
Grants Illusion Form for a set duration. Ends Illusion Form and returns Zankou to Reality Form when Soulcross or Bloodfeast Reverie is successfully cast, when its duration expires, or when Zankou leaves the field. Delays the removal of the Illusion Form <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> effect when switching to Reality Form with Soulcross. Counts all DMG dealt by Soulcross and its enhanced version as Follow-up Attack DMG. Prevents the form switch if the skill is interrupted before it is complete.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 幻境形态下成功释放变轨技能后切换为现实形态，同时<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">「惑」</>延迟清除。幻境状态即将结束时释放强化变轨技能，可对命中的目标施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">「蚀心」</>，并触发<TextHLT>「灭」</>：对大范围目标造成高额伤害，同时激活「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」。幻境状态持续一段时间；成功释放变轨技能或「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」、持续时间结束或残虹离场时，幻境状态解除，残虹回到现实形态。幻境形态下的变轨技能及其强化版本造成的伤害均视为追加攻击。技能在完成形态切换前被打断时，形态不会改变。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Switches to Reality Form after successfully casting Redirect Skill while in Illusion Form. Delays the removal of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</>. Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on targets hit and triggers <TextHLT>Oblivion</> when casting an enhanced Redirect Skill shortly before Illusion Form ends, dealing massive DMG to enemies in a large area, activating Bloodfeast Reverie. Grants Illusion Form for a set duration. Returns Zankou to Reality Form when Redirect Skill or Bloodfeast Reverie is successfully cast, when its duration expires, or when Zankou leaves the field. Counts all DMG dealt by the Illusion Form Redirect Skill and its enhanced version as Follow-up Attack DMG. Prevents the form switch if the skill is interrupted before it is complete.
