Description.SourceString:
终结能量蓄满后，点按即可释放极轨终结技能。残虹拥有「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」和「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」<NumGreen>2</>种极轨终结技能。
如果「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」处于未激活状态，则直接释放「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」；
如果「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」处于激活状态，将会优先释放「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」。「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」造成的伤害视为追加攻击，并为大范围目标施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouUltraDot">「鸩火」</>。成功释放「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」后，在限定时间内再次点按，可释放一次不消耗终结能量且获得强化的「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」。如果超过限定时间，则此次释放机会消失。
Description.LocalizedString:
Press to cast the Ultimate when Ultimate Energy is full. Has <NumGreen>2</> Ultimates: Inferno Flamenco and Bloodfeast Reverie.
Casts Inferno Flamenco if Bloodfeast Reverie is inactive.
Prioritizes Bloodfeast Reverie if it is active. Counts DMG dealt by Bloodfeast Reverie as Follow-up Attack DMG and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouUltraDot">Vile Ash</> on enemies in a large area. Enables one enhanced Inferno Flamenco to be cast without consuming Ultimate Energy within a limited time after successfully casting Bloodfeast Reverie. Removes this cast opportunity when the time limit expires.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
终结能量蓄满后，点按即可释放极轨终结技能。残虹拥有「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」和「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」<NumGreen>2</>种极轨终结技能。
如果「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」处于未激活状态，则直接释放「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」；
如果「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」处于激活状态，将会优先释放「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」。「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」造成的伤害视为追加攻击，并为大范围目标施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouUltraDot">「鸩火」</>。成功释放「极轨终结：血宴入梦时」后，在限定时间内再次点按，可释放一次不消耗终结能量且获得强化的「极轨终结：焚天烬灭舞」。如果超过限定时间，则此次释放机会消失。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Press to cast the Ultimate when Ultimate Energy is full. Has <NumGreen>2</> Ultimates: Inferno Flamenco and Bloodfeast Reverie.
Casts Inferno Flamenco if Bloodfeast Reverie is inactive.
Prioritizes Bloodfeast Reverie if it is active. Counts DMG dealt by Bloodfeast Reverie as Follow-up Attack DMG and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouUltraDot">Vile Ash</> on enemies in a large area. Enables one enhanced Inferno Flamenco to be cast without consuming Ultimate Energy within a limited time after successfully casting Bloodfeast Reverie. Removes this cast opportunity when the time limit expires.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>灵魂之火在幻景中寂灭，如同沉入不必苏醒的酣眠。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>The soul's flame dies within the dream, slipping into a sleep with no need to wake.</>

Desc.SourceString: 强化「焚天烬灭舞」伤害倍率
强化「焚天烬灭舞」追击时限
Desc.LocalizedString: Enhanced Inferno Flamenco Follow-up Attack Window
Bloodfeast Reverie inflicts Vile Ash stacks

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「浊燃」强化</>：「浊燃」效果可叠加，上限<NumGreen>3</>层。全队对「浊燃」状态下的目标施加持续伤害效果时，每施加<NumGreen>1</>层持续伤害效果，就由残虹为其施加<NumGreen>1</>层「浊燃」，已有「浊燃」的伤害、元素类型、持续时间刷新为本次施加的「浊燃」的效果。施加「浊燃」不重复触发此效果。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Scorch can be stacked up to <NumGreen>3</> times. For <NumGreen>each</> DoT effect allies inflict on a target afflicted with Scorch, Zankou inflicts <NumGreen>1</> stack of Scorch on them, replacing the DMG, type, and duration of existing Scorch on the target with those of the newly inflicted effect. Scorch inflicted by this effect cannot trigger it again.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>众生的火焰汇聚成一轮沉默的太阳，将所有的目光灼烧出成同一种颜色。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Countless flames merge into a silent sun, burning every gaze into the same hue.</>

Description.SourceString: 进入战斗时，残虹的「环合值」为<NumGreen>100</>点，此效果有<NumGreen>30</>秒冷却且单场战斗中最多生效<NumGreen>1</>次。此外，残虹在队伍时，自身「环合强度」提升<NumGreen>100</>点。
Description.LocalizedString: Sets Zankou's Cycle Energy to <NumGreen>100</> upon entering battle. Cooldown: <NumGreen>30</>s. Triggers only <NumGreen>once</> per battle. Increases Zankou's Cycle Intensity by <NumGreen>100</> while she is on the team.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 进入战斗时，残虹的「环合值」为<NumGreen>100</>点，此效果有<NumGreen>30</>秒冷却且单场战斗中最多生效<NumGreen>1</>次。此外，残虹在队伍时，自身「环合强度」提升<NumGreen>100</>点。

Description.SourceString: <Italic>沉沦于这片令人迷醉的猩红，在她的眼底永远睡去。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Lose yourself in the intoxicating crimson of her gaze, and never wake again.</>

Description.SourceString:
「无影无形。」
非战斗状态下可使用特殊技能「谲影迷踪」，使残虹进入隐身状态，持续<NumGreen>20</>秒。隐身期间移动速度提升<NumGreen>50%</>，不会被目标发现。
Description.LocalizedString:
"Beyond sight. Beyond reach."
Enters Invisible state for <NumGreen>20</>s upon using the special skill Lost Focus while out of combat. Increases Movement Speed by <NumGreen>50%</> while in Invisible state and prevents enemies from detecting Zankou.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>最初只是一次短暂的对视，随后，整个世界都开始缓缓失焦。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>It began with a fleeting glance. Then the world slowly blurred away.</>

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「延滞」强化</>：当目标的「延滞」状态解除时，卡厄斯将会根据本次「延滞」持续时间对目标造成800%*攻击力的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，基础5秒外，每额外持续1秒整体伤害提升45%，上限300%。重复施加「延滞」状态将重置持续时间。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Remora Enhancement</>: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> equal to 800% of ATK to the target when Remora ends, based on Remora's duration. Each second beyond the base 5s duration increases total DMG by 45%, up to 300%. Resets Remora's duration when reapplied.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>所以你仍旧相信，正确的答案一定能带来光明的结局？</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Do you still believe every right answer leads to light? </>

Description.SourceString: <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">「追缉许可」</>的伤害增加效果提升至<NumGreen>30%</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Increases the damage bonus from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> to <NumGreen>30%</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「我已经走完流程和审批了！」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"All forms filed. All approvals granted." </>

Description.SourceString: 卡厄斯挥动武器，进行至多<NumGreen>5</>段的连续攻击，造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>的同时积累<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">「罪状」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Wields his weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> and building up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 你的罪状，已经一目了然。长按普通攻击，卡厄斯展开镰刀发动「普通攻击：裁断」。若当前<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">「罪状」</>已达上限1000，则消耗全部<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">「罪状」</>，追加第二段「裁断」，造成高额清算伤害；若<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">「罪状」</>未达上限，则只进行第一段「裁断」，造成<NumGreen>2</>次伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: Your guilt is plain to see. Hold Basic Attack to trigger Final Verdict. Consumes all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> to add a 2nd hit to Final Verdict and deal heavy Settlement DMG if current <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> is at its cap (1000). Performs only the 1st hit of Final Verdict, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of damage, if <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> has not reached its cap.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 长按普通攻击造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。若当前<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">「罪状」</>已达上限1000，则消耗全部<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">「罪状」</>额外进行第二段攻击；否则只进行一段攻击。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack to deal <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>. Consumes all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crimes</> to perform an additional 2nd strike if current <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> is at its cap (1000). Otherwise, performs only the 1st strike.

Description.SourceString: 卡厄斯滞空时点按普攻，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升<NumGreen>1</>倍。 与此同时卡厄斯集中精神，开启猎人般的觉察，短时间内能够感知到一定范围内的敌方单位。被感知目标会以特殊轮廓高亮显示。
Description.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to <NumGreen>1×</>. Focuses his mind and awakens a hunter's perception, sensing nearby enemies for a short time. Sensed targets are highlighted with a special outline.

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：追猎」触发。卡厄斯挥动尖斧劈向目标，造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>并额外扣除一定倾陷值。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Pursuit after performing a Critical Dodge. Swings his hatchet at the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> and reducing Break.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>经年累月的磨炼。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Honed over countless years. </>

Desc.SourceString: 分支二段清算伤害倍率
全套普通攻击积攒「罪状」
Desc.LocalizedString: Full Basic Attack combo: Builds up Crime

Description.SourceString: 已确认目标特征。卡厄斯使用手枪对前方目标进行射击，并召唤猎犬扑向目标，猎犬对目标进行来回<NumGreen>2</>次撕咬攻击。技能命中目标后，为最多<NumGreen>2</>名敌人施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">「追缉许可」</>，持续<NumGreen>15</>秒。卡厄斯攻击带有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">「追缉许可」</>的目标时，造成的伤害增加<NumGreen>20%</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Target traits confirmed. Fires at enemies ahead and summons his hound to pounce on the target. The hound bites the target back and forth <NumGreen>twice</>. Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> on up to <NumGreen>2</> enemies for <NumGreen>15</>s when the skill hits. Increases damage dealt by <NumGreen>20%</> when attacking targets with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，并为目标施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">「追缉许可」</>。攻击带有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">「追缉许可」</>的目标时，造成的伤害增加。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> on the target. Deals bonus damage to targets with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>卡厄斯不太记得这条猎犬是什么时候出现的了。似乎是某天，他突然开始想念从前家中的小狗，于是猎犬便出现了。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Chaos can't remember when the hound first appeared. He only remembers missing the little dog from home, and then the hound was there. </>

Desc.SourceString: 施加「追缉许可」目标数量

Description.SourceString: 卡厄斯召唤猎犬压制周围敌人，对范围内所有敌人施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">「追缉许可」</>，并进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosInfamyCycle">「恶名往复」</>状态。卡厄斯在场上且处于「恶名往复」状态时，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">「罪状」</>会持续快速增长，可更频繁发动「裁断」造成高额清算伤害。
Description.LocalizedString: Summons his hound to suppress nearby enemies, inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> on all enemies within range and entering the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosInfamyCycle">Dread Echo</> state. Rapidly increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> over time while Chaos and Dread Echo are active, allowing Final Verdict to be cast more often and deal heavy Settlement DMG.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosInfamyCycle">「恶名往复」</>状态，期间范围内敌人均会被施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">「追缉许可」</>，卡厄斯位于前台时<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">「罪状」</>持续快速增长。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosInfamyCycle">Dread Echo</> state. Rapidly increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> over time while Dread Echo is active and Chaos is on the field, and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> on all enemies within range.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>其实你隐约明白，善恶循环往复，这一切永远不会有尽头。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Deep down, you know good and evil cycle endlessly, and none of it ever truly ends. </>

Description.SourceString: 别想逃跑！卡厄斯挥舞镰刀上劈，造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Don't even think about running! Swings his scythe upward, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>齐心协力、风雨同舟，从前也是如此。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>United in purpose, through fair weather and foul, as they once were. </>

Description.SourceString: 在大世界中，卡厄斯能通过长按瞄准键的方式留下猎犬作为传送锚点。需要传送时，通过地图交互，猎犬将撕咬出连通空间的门扉，卡厄斯由此回到锚点所在之处。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Aim in the open world to leave his hound behind as a teleport anchor. When teleporting from the map, the hound tears open a doorway through space, allowing Chaos to return to the anchor’s location.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>但你追不上过去的影子。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Yet the shadow of the past remains out of reach. </>

Description.SourceString:
释放「普通攻击：恶灵CQC」，灵可进行至多5段的连续攻击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。每段攻击将积攒「谐频」点数。
「谐频」将在使用「变轨技能：瞬息全频振」时消耗，并强化其触发的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Casts Poltergeist CQC to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Builds up Modulation points with each hit.
Casts Full-Frequency Pulse to consume Modulation points and enhance the triggered <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，积攒「谐频」点数。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</> and builds up Modulation points.

Description.SourceString: 「普通攻击：恶灵CQC」释放期间，长按普通攻击触发，灵可双掌拍击当前目标，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during Poltergeist CQC to make Linko strike the current target with both palms, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 「普通攻击：恶灵CQC」释放期间长按普通攻击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during Poltergeist CQC to deal <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 灵可滞空时点按普通攻击，落地后造成1次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height by up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 灵可处于后台时，每隔8秒，将会派出小贞偷袭目标，进行一次攻击并施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">「小鬼打这里！」</>标记。
Description.LocalizedString: Sends Xiaozhen to ambush the target every 8s while Linko is off-field, causing Xiaozhen to attack once and inflict a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">Hit 'Em Here!</> mark.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 灵可处于后台时，定期给敌人施加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">「小鬼打这里！」</>标记。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Periodically inflicts a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">Hit 'Em Here!</> mark while Linko is off-field.

DescriptionTitle.SourceString: 极限反击：挨打必须还「手」！

Description.SourceString: 触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：恶灵CQC」触发，灵可冲向目标造成4次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>并积攒「谐频」点数。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when using Poltergeist CQC after a Critical Dodge. Charges toward the target, dealing 4 instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area and building up Modulation.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，积攒「谐频」点数。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</> and builds up Modulation points.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>「小贞小贞，我有一个想法……用你的手打出欧拉拳套一样的拳击！快到全是残影的那种！」</>
<Italic>「……那是图个啥？全力一拳撂倒不是更高效吗？」</>
<Italic>「你不懂！这是格斗的艺术！」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>"Xiaozhen, Xiaozhen, I've got an idea… What if you threw punches like Ora Puncher? So fast, your fists would be nothing but afterimages!"</>
<Italic>"…Why bother? Wouldn't it be faster to knock them out with one good punch?"</>
<Italic>"You just don't get it! It's an art form!"</>

Desc.LocalizedString: Critical Riposte builds up Modulation Points.

Description.SourceString:
释放「变轨技能：瞬息全频振」，灵可激发异能，用幽灵能量体轰击目标，造成最多4段<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并呼唤小贞或一名队友发动<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>；此时，将出现可选择发起攻击者的轮盘，可通过点按选择一名队友或者小贞，来释放该角色的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>，造成对应的属性伤害。该次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>将获得伤害增益，且会消耗此前积攒的「谐频」点数，转化为额外的伤害增益。
在点选队友、发动<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>的这段时间内，将有短暂的暂停计时效果。
队友不可行动或未编入队伍时，小贞会替代轮盘中队友的位置，每额外有一个小贞，选择小贞触发的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>额外获得一次伤害增益。
若在“设置-系统功能”中开启自动释放技能，默认选择队伍第一个角色释放<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Channels Esper Ability upon casting Full-Frequency Pulse, bombarding the target with ghost energy to deal up to 4 instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and calling Xiaozhen or an ally to perform a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>. Opens a selection wheel to choose Xiaozhen or an ally, then performs the selected character's <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>, dealing DMG of the corresponding attribute. Grants this <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> a DMG Bonus and consumes all accumulated Modulation, converting it into an additional DMG Bonus.
Briefly pauses the battle timer while selecting the attacker and initiating the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>.
Replaces an ally's position on the wheel with Xiaozhen if the ally is unable to act or is not on the team. Grants Xiaozhen's <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> an additional DMG Bonus for each additional Xiaozhen on the wheel.
Enable Auto-Cast Skills under "Settings > System Features" to have the first ally in the team perform <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> by default.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 点按发动，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，选择并发动小贞或一名同队角色的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>，造成对应属性异能伤害，并消耗已有「谐频」点数，增幅此次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>的伤害。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Press to deal <Ling>Anima DMG</>, select Xiaozhen or an ally on the team to perform a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> that deals DMG of the corresponding attribute, and consume all accumulated Modulation to increase this <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>'s DMG.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>「瞧好了！这就是我们热血沸腾的组合技——」</>
<Italic>「……话说小鬼，刚刚那个人我们真的认识吗？」</>
<Italic>「我没看清楚是谁——但总之接上了！」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>"Watch this! Our red-hot tag-team finisher…"</>
<Italic>"…Wait, kid. Did we even know that person?"</>
<Italic>"Didn't catch who it was, but the combo worked!"</>

Description.SourceString:
释放「极轨终结：超负荷共鸣」，灵可进入异能过载状态，展开持续一定时间的「共鸣领域」，并与至多3名同队角色达成同频。可以通过点按变轨技能依次呼唤队友释放<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>，最多释放3次，「共鸣领域」内释放<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>时灵可会额外造成1次范围性<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
等待异能过载状态结束、或者点按「极轨终结：超负荷共鸣」提前结束时，灵可释放过载的噪波，对「共鸣领域」内的所有敌方单位造成多次范围性的<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>和一次<Ling>灵属性爆发伤害</>。该<Ling>灵属性爆发伤害</>根据目标身上的负面状态数量提升。
在「超负荷共鸣」持续时间结束后，灵可的「共鸣领域」将延续一段时间。「共鸣领域」内队伍角色触发的援护技均视为<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>，视为追加攻击伤害，并额外享受「精确调频」、「星星也说悄悄话！」、「世界将予你回声！」的加成。
若在“设置-系统功能”中开启自动释放技能，默认队伍角色依次释放<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Enters Overdrive upon casting Oversync, deploying a Resonance Field for a set duration and Syncing with up to 3 allies. Allows Redirect Skill to be pressed to call on Synced allies in sequence to perform <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</>, up to 3 times. Deals 1 additional instance of <Ling>Anima Area DMG</> when a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> is performed within Resonance Field.
Ends Overdrive when its duration expires or when Oversync is pressed again, releasing an overloaded noise burst that deals multiple instances of <Ling>Anima Area DMG</> and 1 instance of <Ling>Anima Burst DMG</> to all enemies within Resonance Field. Increases this <Ling>Anima Burst DMG</> based on the number of different debuffs on each target.
Extends Resonance Field for a set duration after Overdrive ends. Counts Support Skills triggered by allies within Resonance Field as <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</>, treats their DMG as Follow-up Attack DMG, and grants them the bonuses from Precision Tuning, Starlit Whispers, and The World Answers.
Enable Auto-Cast Skills under "Settings > System Features" to have allies perform <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</> in sequence by default.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
点按发动，展开持续一定时间的「共鸣领域」；点按变轨技能发动同队角色<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>，最多发动三次；再次点按极轨终结技能，造成范围性<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
「共鸣领域」内，角色援护技均视为<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Press to deploy a Resonance Field for a set duration. Press Redirect Skill to call on allies to perform <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</>, up to 3 times. Press Ultimate again to deal <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area.
While within Resonance Field, allies' Support Skills are considered <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</>.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>没有无法接通的频道，没有无法触达的孤岛，没有无法回应的呼唤，没有无法跨越的阻隔……</>
<Italic>因为电波终将指引我们相遇，即使初见也如久别重逢。</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>No signal is ever truly lost. No one is ever beyond reach. No call goes unheard, and no distance can keep us apart…</>
<Italic>The airwaves will always bring us together, until meeting for the first time feels like finding each other again.</>

Description.SourceString:
灵可与小贞对目标打出认真一拳，造成1次范围性<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
灵可在战斗中可通过：
击碎<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">「小鬼打这里！」</>标记，释放「变轨技能：瞬息全频振」，释放「极轨终结：超负荷共鸣」三种方式召唤队友进行<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>的伤害倍率受灵可「援护技：恶灵左直拳！」技能等级影响。
Description.LocalizedString:
Strikes the target together with Xiaozhen, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area.
Summons an ally to perform a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> by breaking a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">Hit 'Em Here!</> mark, casting Full-Frequency Pulse, or casting Oversync. Scales <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>'s DMG Ratio with Spectral Cross's skill level.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>的伤害倍率受灵可「援护技：恶灵左直拳！」技能等级影响。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Scales <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>'s DMG Ratio with Spectral Cross's skill level.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>「假如小贞不在身边，而我遇到了坏人的话……」</>
<Italic>「直接逃呗，你那小短腿不是跑得挺快的。」</>
<Italic>「才不要——噢！我可以抡着电视机砸上去！」</>
<Italic>「不行……绝！对！不！行！」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>"What if some creep comes after me when you're not around…?"</>
<Italic>"Run. Those tiny legs of yours can really move."</>
<Italic>"No way! Wait, I know. I'll hit them with the TV!"</>
<Italic>"No. Absolutely not. Under any circumstances."</>

Desc.SourceString: 灵可「同频合击」伤害倍率
小贞「同频合击」伤害倍率

Description.SourceString: <TextHLT>「覆纹」强化</>：灵可在队伍中时，「覆纹」的额外追加攻击伤害基础值提升至30%；受「覆纹」状态影响的目标，队伍造成的追加攻击伤害提高10%。
Description.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Hexed Enhancement</>: Increases the base DMG of additional Follow-up Attacks from Hexed to 30% while Linko is on the team. Targets affected by Hexed take 10% more Follow-up Attack DMG.

ShortDescription.SourceString: <TextHLT>「覆纹」强化</>：灵可在队伍中时，「覆纹」的额外追加攻击伤害基础值提升至30%；受「覆纹」状态影响的目标，队伍造成的追加攻击伤害提高10%。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: <TextHLT>Hexed Enhancement</>: Increases the base DMG of additional Follow-up Attacks from Hexed to 30% while Linko is on the team. Targets affected by Hexed take 10% more Follow-up Attack DMG.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>那频段中的噪点，如同一道难以察觉的裂纹，这道伤痕为什么出现？又为什么无法愈合？</>
<Italic>在某个瞬间，她甚至会为此感到难过。</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>The faint static in that frequency felt like a crack no one else could see. How had it formed? And why did it refuse to heal?</>
<Italic>Sometimes, for just a moment, the thought left her quietly heartsick.</>

Description.SourceString: 触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>时，将根据触发此次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>的角色，降低目标对应属性8%的异能抗性，持续12秒。目标身上可同时存在多种属性的减抗效果，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>造成的同种属性的减抗效果不可叠加，重复触发将刷新持续时间。
Description.LocalizedString: Reduces the target's Esper Ability Resistance corresponding to the attribute of the character who triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> by 8% for 12s. Resistance Reduction effects for different attributes can coexist on the same target. Effects of the same attribute inflicted by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> do not stack. Resets the duration when triggered again.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>时，将根据触发此次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>的角色，降低目标对应属性8%的异能抗性，持续12秒。目标身上可同时存在多种属性的减抗效果，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>造成的同种属性的减抗效果不可叠加，重复触发将刷新持续时间。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Reduces the target's Esper Ability Resistance corresponding to the attribute of the character who triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> by 8% for 12s. Resistance Reduction effects for different attributes can coexist on the same target. Effects of the same attribute inflicted by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> do not stack. Resets the duration when triggered again.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>言语和文字不能传达万分之一的感受，而此刻，我们的灵魂将百分之百地相拥。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>Words could never come close to expressing what we feel. But in this moment, our souls finally meet without distance between them.</>

Description.SourceString: 非战斗状态下长按普通攻击，灵可借助小贞的幽灵手臂蓄力，松开后会将灵可弹射出去，蓄力时间越长，弹射力度越大，最多蓄力2秒。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack while out of combat to charge up using Xiaozhen's ghostly arm. Release to launch Linko forward. Increases launch force with charge time, up to a maximum charge time of 2s.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 非战斗状态下长按普通攻击，灵可借助小贞的幽灵手臂蓄力，松开后会将灵可弹射出去，蓄力时间越长，弹射力度越大，最多蓄力2秒。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack while out of combat to charge up using Xiaozhen's ghostly arm. Release to launch Linko forward. Increases launch force with charge time, up to a maximum charge time of 2s.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>「糟糕！要迟到了！小贞，快启动紧急弹射程序，目的地异象管理局二楼窗户！」</>
<Italic>「……你就不能正常走电话亭吗？」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>"Shoot, we're late! Xiaozhen, fire up the emergency launch system! Aim for the BAC's second-floor window!"</>
<Italic>"…Or you could just take the phone booth like a normal person."</>

Description.SourceString: 黑羽使用「链笼」，进行至多五段的连续攻击，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中目标可获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Uses Chain Cage to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>. Gains <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</>. Gains <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

Description.SourceString: 「普通攻击：掠影」第1/2/3段中，长按普通攻击可发动「普通攻击：归巢」，黑羽使用「链笼」囚禁目标，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，并在一定时间内大幅度降低目标移动速度。命中目标可获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd hit of Fleeting Shadow to trigger Roostcall, imprisoning the target with Chain Cage, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>, and greatly reducing their Movement Speed for a set duration. Gains <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 「普通攻击：掠影」第1/2/3段中长按普攻，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，并降低目标移速。命中获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd hit of Fleeting Shadow, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>, and reducing the target's Movement Speed. Gains <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

Description.SourceString: 黑羽滞空时点按普攻，落地后造成1次范围性的<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。命中目标可获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing 1 instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height by up to 100%. Gains <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 滞空时点按普攻，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne to deal <Hun>Psyche DMG</>. Gains <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

Description.SourceString: 黑羽触发极限闪避后使用「普通攻击：掠影」触发，对目标发动攻击，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中目标可获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Triggers when Blackbird uses Fleeting Shadow after a Critical Dodge, attacking the target to deal <Hun>Psyche DMG</>. Gains <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</>. Gains <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

Description.SourceString: 黑羽被烈火吞没，火光中<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>出现，进行至多五段的连续攻击，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中目标可消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Blackbird is engulfed in flames, and the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> emerges from the blaze, unleashing up to 5 consecutive attacks that deal <Hun>Psyche DMG</>. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

ShortDescription.SourceString: <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>状态下，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> state. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

DescriptionTitle.SourceString: 普通攻击：予尔等之恩泽

Description.SourceString: 「普通攻击：祭火」第2段中，长按普通攻击可发动「普通攻击：予尔等之恩泽」，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>升空，短暂蓄力后造成大范围<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中目标可消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during the 2nd hit of Pyreflame to trigger Bestowed Grace. The <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> rises into the air, briefly charges up, then deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> over a large area. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 「普通攻击：祭火」第2段中长按普攻，造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during the 2nd hit of Pyreflame to deal <Hun>Psyche DMG</>. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

DescriptionTitle.SourceString: 普通攻击：赐众生之福音

Description.SourceString: 「普通攻击：予尔等之恩泽」或变轨技能「渡世死焰」期间，长按普通攻击可发动「普通攻击：赐众生之福音」，并对目标造成多段<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中目标可消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Hold Basic Attack during Bestowed Grace or Flames of Deliverance to trigger Tidings Unto All, dealing multiple instances of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to the target. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

Description.SourceString:
黑羽发动「普通攻击：掠影」、「普通攻击：归巢」、「普通攻击：顽疾」、「极限反击：鸟类本能」、「承轨反击：裁灭」、「变轨技能：葬羽冥」后，分别获得不同点数的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
入战立即获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
黑羽处于<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>状态下时，无法获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>，发动「普通攻击：祭火」、「普通攻击：灼痕」、「普通攻击：予尔等之恩泽」、「普通攻击：赐众生之福音」、「极限反击：生于灾厄」、「变轨技能：渡世死焰」、「援护技：唯余慈悲」后，可消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>，造成额外<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>伤害。
Description.LocalizedString:
Generates varying amounts of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> upon casting Fleeting Shadow, Roostcall, Lingering Affliction, Avian Instinct, Last Word, or Netherplume Rite.
Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> immediately upon entering battle.
Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> from being gained while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> state. Allows <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> to be consumed after casting Pyreflame, Searing Scar, Bestowed Grace, Tidings Unto All, Born of Calamity, Flames of Deliverance, or Naught but Mercy to deal additional <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> DMG.

黑羽使用「链笼」，对目标造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，并对命中的目标附加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoePlume">「失乐羽」</>印记，持续一段时间。释放可获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoePlume">「失乐羽」</>印记持续期间，队伍中其他角色驻场对带有印记的目标造成伤害时，会触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoeBird">「失乐鸟」</>协同攻击。<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoeBird">「失乐鸟」</>对该目标造成范围性<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>，最短间隔2秒触发一次，至多可触发5次。
Description.LocalizedString:
Uses Chain Cage to deal <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to the target and inflict a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoePlume">Forsaken Feather</> mark on targets hit for a set duration. Casts to gain <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</>.
While <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoePlume">Forsaken Feather</> is active, triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoeBird">Forsaken Bird</> to perform a coordinated attack when another active ally deals DMG to the marked target. <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoeBird">Forsaken Bird</> deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> in an area around the target. Triggers no more than once every 2s, up to 5 times in total.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 对命中的目标附加<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoePlume">「失乐羽」</>印记。队伍中其他角色驻场对带有印记的目标造成伤害时，会触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoeBird">「失乐鸟」</>协同攻击，造成范围性<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Inflicts a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoePlume">Forsaken Feather</> mark on targets hit. When another active ally deals DMG to a marked target, triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdwoeBird">Forsaken Bird</> to perform a coordinated attack, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</> in an area.

Description.SourceString:
黑羽处于<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>状态下时，高速冲向目标，并造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中目标可消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
激活条件：<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>通过发动「普通攻击：祭火」第5段、承轨反击「无悲」后可激活「变轨技能：渡世死焰」。该技能默认处于未激活状态。
Description.LocalizedString:
Charges toward the target at high speed while Blackbird is in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> state, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.
Activation: Activates after <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> performs the 5th hit of Pyreflame or casts No Quarter. This skill is inactive by default.

ShortDescription.SourceString: <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>通过发动「普通攻击：祭火」第5段、承轨反击「无悲」后激活「变轨技能：渡世死焰」，对目标造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Activates after <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> performs the 5th hit of Pyreflame or casts No Quarter, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to the target. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>To the fire, flesh and bone; to the sky, feather and claw.</>

Description.SourceString:
黑羽化身<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>，发起多段攻击，对目标造成高额<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>拥有持续时间，期间免疫硬直、移动速度提高，持续时间结束后自动恢复到黑羽。处于后台时，持续时间不再减少。
发动「极轨终结：恳请众魂安息」后提升全队角色的攻击力。
Description.LocalizedString:
Transforms into the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> and launches multiple attacks, dealing massive <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to the target.
Gains Hitstun Immunity and increases Movement Speed while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> state, which lasts for a set duration. Reverts to Blackbird when the duration ends. The duration does not decrease while she is off-field.
Increases the entire team' ATK after casting Requies Animarum.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 黑羽化身<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>，造成多段高额<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。释放后提升全队角色的攻击力。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Transforms into the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</>, dealing multiple instances of massive <Hun>Psyche DMG</>. Increases all allies' ATK after casting.

Description.SourceString: 黑羽退出<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>状态，对目标发起多段攻击，造成高额<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Exits the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> state and launches multiple attacks against the target, dealing massive <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: 鸟儿会将找到的一切尽数交付与我……黑羽化作「伶仃鸟」，对目标造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中目标可获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: The bird will deliver everything it finds to me. Transforms into Lonesome Bird and deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to the target. Gains <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。

Description.SourceString: 接受魔女的祝福吧。<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">「救世的魔女」</>对目标造成<Hun>魂属性异能伤害</>。命中目标可消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Accept the Witch's blessing. Deals <Hun>Psyche DMG</> while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdSaviorWitch">Witch of Deliverance</> state. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> after hitting an enemy.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>祂来到这里，降福于大地，于是人们赞美祂，歌颂祂，奉养祂，吞食祂。</>
<Italic>「啊！祂是多么无私的救世主！」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>He came to this land and blessed the earth. And the people praised Him, sang of Him, sustained Him, and fed upon Him.</>
<Italic>"Ah! What a selfless savior He is!"</>

Desc.LocalizedString: Malice cost by Naught but Mercy

Description.SourceString:
<TextHLT>「浸染」强化</>：「浸染」的基础增伤效果提升至<NumGreen>30%</>，持续时间延长至<NumGreen>20</>秒。

<TextHLT>「黯星」强化</>：「黯星」状态结束时，根据「黯星」期间目标实际受到的累计伤害，黑羽额外对其造成相当于累计伤害<NumGreen>20%</>的心灵伤害（累计伤害不包含触发该次黯星状态的援护技和该次黯星状态自身造成的伤害），最高不超过黑羽基础攻击力的<NumGreen>1000</>倍，且不受其他伤害增减益效果影响。随后，由黑羽为目标施加1次「黯星」。
通过本效果施加的「黯星」无法再次触发施加「黯星」效果。
Description.LocalizedString:
<TextHLT>Stain Enhancement</>: Increases Stain's base DMG Bonus to <NumGreen>30%</> and extends its duration to <NumGreen>20</>s.

<TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: When Nova ends, deals additional Mental DMG equal to <NumGreen>20%</> of the actual total DMG taken by the target while Nova was active (excluding DMG dealt by the Support Skill that triggered Nova and by Nova itself), up to <NumGreen>1,000×</> Blackbird's Base ATK. This additional DMG is not affected by any other DMG Buffs or Debuffs. Inflicts Nova on the target once afterward.
Prevents Nova inflicted by this effect from triggering the Nova reapplication effect again.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「完了，结束了，完了，结束了。我们在死亡，在死亡。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"All over. All done. All over. All done. We are dying. We are dying."</>

Description.SourceString: 黑羽发动「援护技：断罪于我」时，获得<NumGreen>20</>点<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">「恶意」</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Grants <NumGreen>20</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Blackbirdmalice">Malice</> when Blackbird casts Judgment Upon Me.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「一百年行走，一百年飞翔，一百年追寻，一百年歌唱。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"A hundred years to wander, a hundred years to fly, a hundred years to seek, a hundred years to sing."</>

Desc.LocalizedString: Malice generated by Judgment Upon Me

Description.SourceString: 黑羽在非战斗状态下，地面状态长按闪避或者空中下落状态按瞄准键，可化作<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdlornBird">「伶仃鸟」</>高速飞行，可收取一定范围内的谕石，飞行期间会消耗耐力。
Description.LocalizedString: While out of combat, hold Dodge while on the ground, or press Aim while falling, to transform Blackbird into <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&BlackbirdlornBird">Lonesome Bird</>, fly at high speed, and collect nearby Oracle Stones. Consumes Stamina while flying.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「你是我的火呀歌呀爱呀眼泪呀祈祷呀厄运呀灵魂呀世界呀，而我是你呀。」</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"You are my fire, my song, my love, my tears; my prayer, my doom, my soul, my world—and I am you."</>

Description.SourceString: 明音凛使用电吉他与音刃进行至多<NumGreen>4</>段连续攻击，造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。明音凛的各类伤害命中目标时，可获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneChordEnergy">「弦能」</>，上限为<NumGreen>30</>点。
Description.LocalizedString: Performs up to <NumGreen>4</> consecutive attacks using an electric guitar and Feathered Sound Blade, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>. Generates <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneChordEnergy">String Energy</> whenever Akane Rin deals DMG to a target. String Energy has a cap of <NumGreen>30</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 明音凛进行至多<NumGreen>4</>段的连续攻击，造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，命中目标时可获得<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneChordEnergy">「弦能」</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Wields her weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>4</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> and generating <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneChordEnergy">String Energy</> upon hitting a target.

Description.SourceString: 明音凛滞空时点按普通攻击，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
Description.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> in an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, by up to 100%.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 明音凛滞空时点按普通攻击，落地后造成<NumGreen>1</>次范围性的<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，伤害随下落高度升高而提升，最高提升1倍。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> in an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, by up to 100%.

Description.SourceString:
明音凛的「变轨技能：律动音浪」具有两种释放方式。
点按技能：给目标附着持续<NumGreen>25</>秒的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>，并造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。明音凛进行普通攻击时，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>发出共鸣，将本次普通攻击远距离传导至其附着的目标，并使本次传导的「普通攻击：弦刃」或「极限反击：羽刃回响」倍率按一定比例提升。
长按技能：展开持续<NumGreen>25</>秒的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>，对范围内的敌人造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。明音凛进行普通攻击时，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>发出共鸣，将本次普通攻击传导至<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>，对范围内所有敌人造成<NumGreen>1</>次普通攻击伤害，并使本次传导的「普通攻击：弦刃」或「极限反击：羽刃回响」获得额外的伤害提升。
场上只能存在<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>或<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>中的一个，新形态成功建立后取代旧形态。两种释放方式共享同一冷却时间，冷却结束后可重新选择形态。
当<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneChordEnergy">「弦能」</>达到<NumGreen>30</>且场上存在有效<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>或<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>时，点按变轨技能可释放强化变轨技能「同调共振」，根据当前形态产生对应效果：
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>：对其附着的目标造成<NumGreen>1</>次高额单体<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>；
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>：对范围内所有敌人造成<NumGreen>1</>次高额<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
「同调共振」命中后消耗<NumGreen>30</>点<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneChordEnergy">「弦能」</>，未命中则不消耗。原本的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>或<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>继续存在，剩余持续时间不刷新。释放「同调共振」期间，明音凛无敌且免疫硬直。
「同调共振」没有独立冷却时间，也不会影响「变轨技能：律动音浪」的冷却时间。
场上没有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>或<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>时，无法释放「同调共振」，需要先点按或长按「变轨技能：律动音浪」建立形态。
Description.LocalizedString:
Offers two casting methods for Akane Rin's Rhythm Wave.
Press: Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> on the target for <NumGreen>25</>s and deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>. Causes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> to resonate when Akane Rin launches a Basic Attack, relaying this attack over long range to the affected target and increasing the DMG Ratio of the relayed Stringblade or Featherblade Reverb by a certain amount.
Hold: Deploys a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> for <NumGreen>25</>s and deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to enemies within range. Causes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> to resonate when Akane Rin performs a Basic Attack, relaying this attack through the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">field</> to deal <NumGreen>1</> instance of Basic Attack DMG to all enemies within range and increasing the DMG of the relayed Stringblade or Featherblade Reverb by an additional amount.
Allows only one <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> to exist at a time. Replaces the existing form when a new form is successfully established. Shares the same cooldown between both casting methods and allows either form to be selected again once the cooldown ends.
Press Redirect Skill to cast Synced Resonance when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneChordEnergy">String Energy</> reaches <NumGreen>30</> and an active <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> is present. Triggers different enhanced effects based on the current form:
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</>: deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of massive single-target <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to the affected target.
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</>: deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of massive <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to enemies within range.
Consumes <NumGreen>30</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneChordEnergy">String Energy</> when Synced Resonance hits and consumes none if it misses. Preserves the existing <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> without refreshing its remaining duration. Grants Akane Rin invincibility and immunity to hitstun while casting Synced Resonance.
Synced Resonance has no independent cooldown and does not affect Rhythm Wave's normal cooldown.
Prevents Synced Resonance from being cast when neither <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> nor <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> is active, requiring pressing or holding Rhythm Wave to establish a form first.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
明音凛的变轨技能具有两种释放方式。
点按技能：给目标附着<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>。明音凛进行普通攻击时，将本次攻击的伤害远距离传导至带有<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>的目标。
长按技能：展开<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>。明音凛进行普通攻击时，将本次攻击的伤害传导至<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>内的所有敌人。

ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Offers two casting methods for Akane Rin's Redirect Skill.
Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> on the target when pressed. Relays Akane Rin's Basic Attack DMG over long range to the target affected by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</>.
Deploys <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> when held. Relays Akane Rin's Basic Attack DMG to all targets within <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</>.
Allows only one <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> to exist on the field at a time.

Description.SourceString:
释放「极轨终结：音障爆鸣」第一段时，明音凛对目标范围内的敌人造成多次高额<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，并进入持续<NumGreen>20</>秒的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">「华彩连段」</>状态，期间明音凛的抗打断能力提升。
在<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">「华彩连段」</>持续4秒后，可随时再次点按极轨终结，释放第二段并提前结束<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">「华彩连段」</>状态，对目标范围内的敌人造成<NumGreen>1</>次高额<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。第二段需手动释放，不会在状态结束时自动触发。状态结束时仍未释放，第二段将失效。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">「华彩连段」</>状态独立于<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>和<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>，不会移除或替代当前生效的效果。
明音凛处于脱离战斗状态时，每秒获得<NumGreen>3</>点终结能量。
Description.LocalizedString:
Casts the first instance of Sonic Boom, dealing multiple instances of massive <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to enemies within the target area and entering <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">Solo Cadenza</> for <NumGreen>20</>s. Increases her Resistance to Interruptions while the state is active.
Allows the second instance to be cast by pressing Sonic Boom again at any time after <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">Solo Cadenza</> has been active for 4s, ending <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">Solo Cadenza</> early, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of massive <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to enemies within the target area. Requires the second instance to be cast manually. Does not automatically cast the second instance when Solo Cadenza ends. The second instance becomes unavailable if not cast before Solo Cadenza ends.
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">Solo Cadenza</> functions independently of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> and <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> and does not remove or replace either effect.
Grants Akane Rin <NumGreen>3</> Ultimate Energy per second while she is out of combat.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>观察笔记#■■■</>
<Italic>研究对象：即时通讯</>

<Italic>由人类「想要即时得到回应」的欲望催生。若发信者输入「想要倾诉的话」，便能从另一个发信者处得到回应。</>
<Italic>该类连接稳定性差，接收方所面向的对象为发信者的数字化身，能否得到回应却取决于对应的人类本体。</>
<Italic>针对被试#■■■的实验表明，即时性的短接故障将数字化身与本体分离，显著提高了双方的满意度。</>
<Italic>该研究仍在持续进行。</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>Observation Note #■■■</>
<Italic>Research Subject: Instant Messaging</>

<Italic>Instant messaging arose from the human desire to "get an immediate response." A sender can type out "something they want to get off their chest" and receive a reply from the recipient.</>
<Italic>Such connections are unstable. The recipient interacts with the sender's digital avatar, but whether they get a response depends on the human original.</>
<Italic>An experiment involving Test Subject #■■■ found that a brief loss of connection between a digital avatar and its human original significantly increased satisfaction on both sides.</>
<Italic>This research is ongoing.</>

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>我们每天度过的日常，其实也许是奇迹的延续。</>
<Italic>你，又会在昨日光景中看到谁的掠影？</>

曳尔沐的「极轨终结：一如昨日光景」存在对单/对群两种形态。
处于<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">「弱信号」</>状态时，「极轨终结：一如昨日光景」默认为对群形态；
处于<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">「中等信号」</>或<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">「强信号」</>状态时，「极轨终结：一如昨日光景」会依据「变轨技能：不连续的存在」、「变轨技能：对你说再见」以及曳尔沐在场时释放的「援护技：我在」的目标检索结果，自动切换对应的对单/对群形态。
「极轨终结：一如昨日光景」的伤害倍率依据释放时的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">「信号强度」</>确定。释放「极轨终结：一如昨日光景」或脱战后，<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">「信号强度」</>重置为<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">「弱信号」</>。

释放「极轨终结：一如昨日光景」后，全队角色获得基于曳尔沐自身基础攻击力的攻击提升，同时全队角色造成的追加攻击伤害提升，持续一定时间。
同时曳尔沐获得增益状态<TextHLT>「后台连线」</>，状态持续期间，若曳尔沐处于后台，则会自动触发协同攻击<TextHLT>「追忆」</>。
协同攻击<TextHLT>「追忆」</>的对单/对群形态与此前释放的「极轨终结：一如昨日光景」相同，其伤害倍率依据该次「极轨终结：一如昨日光景」释放时的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">「信号强度」</>确定。
<TextHLT>「追忆」</>造成的伤害视为追加攻击伤害。
<TextHLT>「追忆」</>释放次数达到上限后，<TextHLT>「后台连线」</>状态结束。
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>The ordinary moments of our lives may be miracles still unfolding.</>
<Italic>Whose fleeting shadow will you glimpse in a scene from yesterday?</>

Features both single-target and AoE forms.
Defaults to the AoE form at <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</>.
At <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Medium Connection</> or <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Strong Connection</>, automatically switches between the two forms based on the target-scan results of the Intermittent Existence, Goodbye to You, and I'm Here while she is active.
The DMG Ratio of Do You Get Deja Vu is determined by her <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Connection Strength</> at the time of casting. After casting or leaving combat, her <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Connection Strength</> resets to <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Weak Connection</>.

Grants the whole team an ATK Bonus based on her Base ATK after casting Do You Get Deja Vu, increasing their Follow-up Attack DMG for a limited time.
Grants the <TextHLT>On the Line</> buff. While this buff is active, <TextHLT>Remembrance</> automatically triggers as a coordinated attack if Elyms is off-field.
<TextHLT>Remembrance</> takes the same single-target or AoE form as the preceding Do You Get Deja Vu, with its DMG Ratio determined by her <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Elyms_propNoun1">Connection Strength</> when that skill was cast.
<TextHLT>DMG dealt by Remembrance</> counts as Follow-up Attack DMG.
<TextHLT>The On the Line</> buff ends when <TextHLT>Remembrance</> reaches its use limit.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>再平凡不过的一天，一起打开还没通关的游戏，一起消磨时间，被无关紧要的小事逗笑，去常吃的小店，在路上告别，约定下一次再见。</>
<Italic>重复发生的日常，一如昨日光景。</>

<Italic>一切都未曾改变，一切都不会改变，只要这样就好……</>
<Italic>肯定请按1，肯定请按2，肯定请按3，肯定请按4，肯定请按5，肯定请按6，肯定请按7，肯定请按8，肯定请按9，肯定请按0，肯定请按#。</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>Just another ordinary day. We booted up the game we still hadn't finished, hung out, laughed at the silliest little things, stopped by our usual spot, said our goodbyes, and promised to meet again.</>
<Italic>The same routine, playing out just like yesterday.</>

<Italic>Nothing has changed, and nothing ever will. If only things could stay this way…</>
<Italic>To confirm, press 1. To confirm, press 2. To confirm, press 3. To confirm, press 4. To confirm, press 5. To confirm, press 6. To confirm, press 7. To confirm, press 8. To confirm, press 9. To confirm, press 0. To confirm, press #.</>

Description.SourceString:
「帧数」:单位时间内的行动效率需要提高。
Exe的攻击命中目标时，可捕获短暂的时间优势，获取「帧数」累积。
「评分」:战斗无非是一项处理数字的工作。
Exe使用「评分」系统量化自己的工作表现，用以优化效率。
「评分」数值会在战斗中随着Exe的战斗行为累积，攻击命中，释放变轨技能、极轨终结、援护技，或触发极限闪避、极限反击、承轨反击等都可以提升评分。
队伍每次触发异能环合时，额外给Exe增加「评分」
「评分」初始分为B-A-S-SS-SSS 五个等级，每个等级评分积满提升至下一级。等级越高，「帧数」的累积效率越高。
「评分」数值在不提高时，会随时间自然回落；Exe受击会大额降低评分。
Description.LocalizedString:
Frames: There's always room to work faster.
Gains Frames by landing attacks and seizing brief windows of opportunity.
Rating: Combat is just another set of numbers to crunch.
Tracks combat performance through the Rating system to work more efficiently.
Increases Rating by landing hits, using Redirect Skills, his Ultimate, or Support Skills, or triggering Critical Dodges, Critical Ripostes, or Parry Attacks.
Gains Rating whenever the ally triggers an Esper Cycle.
Features five Rating tiers: B, A, S, SS, and SSS. Advances to the next tier when the Rating gauge fills. Increases the rate of Frame accumulation at higher tiers.
Causes Rating to gradually decay when it stops increasing and to drop sharply when Exe takes a hit.

Description.SourceString:
释放「变轨技能：瞬息全频振」，灵可激发异能，用幽灵能量体轰击目标，造成最多4段<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，并呼唤小贞或一名队友发动<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>；此时，将出现可选择发起攻击者的轮盘，可通过点按选择一名队友或者小贞，来释放该角色的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>，造成对应的属性伤害。该次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>将获得伤害增益，且会消耗此前积攒的「谐频」点数，转化为额外的伤害增益。
在点选队友、发动<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>的这段时间内，将有短暂的暂停计时效果。
队友不可行动或未编入队伍时，小贞会替代轮盘中队友的位置，每额外有一个小贞，选择小贞触发的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>额外获得一次伤害增益。
若在“设置-系统功能”中开启自动释放技能，默认选择队伍第一个角色释放<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>。
Description.LocalizedString:
Channels Esper Ability upon casting Full-Frequency Pulse, bombarding the target with ghost energy to deal up to 4 instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and calling Xiaozhen or an ally to perform a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>. Opens a selection wheel to choose Xiaozhen or an ally, then performs the selected character's <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>, dealing DMG of the corresponding attribute. Grants this <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> a DMG Bonus and consumes all accumulated Modulation, converting it into an additional DMG Bonus.
Briefly pauses the battle timer while selecting the attacker and initiating the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>.
Replaces an ally's position on the wheel with Xiaozhen if the ally is unable to act or is not on the team. Grants Xiaozhen's <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> an additional DMG Bonus for each additional Xiaozhen on the wheel.
Enable Auto-Cast Skills under "Settings > System Features" to have the first ally in the team perform <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> by default.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 点按发动，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，选择并发动小贞或一名同队角色的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>，造成对应属性异能伤害，并消耗已有「谐频」点数，增幅此次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>的伤害。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Press to deal <Ling>Anima DMG</>, select Xiaozhen or an ally on the team to perform a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> that deals DMG of the corresponding attribute, and consume all accumulated Modulation to increase this <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>'s DMG.

Description.SourceString:
<Italic>「瞧好了！这就是我们热血沸腾的组合技——」</>
<Italic>「……话说小鬼，刚刚那个人我们真的认识吗？」</>
<Italic>「我没看清楚是谁——但总之接上了！」</>
Description.LocalizedString:
<Italic>"Watch this! Our red-hot tag-team finisher…"</>
<Italic>"…Wait, kid. Did we even know that person?"</>
<Italic>"Didn't catch who it was, but the combo worked!"</>

Description.SourceString: 明音凛重扫琴弦，对目标造成<NumGreen>1</>次<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
Description.LocalizedString: Strikes the strings with a powerful strum, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

ShortDescription.SourceString: 对目标造成<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>真正优秀的吉他，总是能够在最完美的时机切入。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>A truly great guitarist always knows exactly when to kick in.</>

Desc.SourceString: 伤害倍率及获得的「弦能」

Description.SourceString:
释放「极轨终结：音障爆鸣」第一段时，明音凛对目标范围内的敌人造成多次高额<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，并进入持续<NumGreen>20</>秒的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">「华彩连段」</>状态，期间明音凛的抗打断能力提升。
在<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">「华彩连段」</>持续4秒后，可随时再次点按极轨终结，释放第二段并提前结束<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">「华彩连段」</>状态，对目标范围内的敌人造成<NumGreen>1</>次高额<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。第二段需手动释放，不会在状态结束时自动触发。状态结束时仍未释放，第二段将失效。
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">「华彩连段」</>状态独立于<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>和<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>，不会移除或替代当前生效的效果。
明音凛处于脱离战斗状态时，每秒获得<NumGreen>3</>点终结能量。
Description.LocalizedString:
Casts the first instance of Sonic Boom, dealing multiple instances of massive <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to enemies within the target area and entering <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">Solo Cadenza</> for <NumGreen>20</>s. Increases her Resistance to Interruptions while the state is active.
Allows the second instance to be cast by pressing Sonic Boom again at any time after <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">Solo Cadenza</> has been active for 4s, ending <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">Solo Cadenza</> early, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of massive <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to enemies within the target area. Requires the second instance to be cast manually. Does not automatically cast the second instance when Solo Cadenza ends. The second instance becomes unavailable if not cast before Solo Cadenza ends.
<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">Solo Cadenza</> functions independently of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> and <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> and does not remove or replace either effect.
Grants Akane Rin <NumGreen>3</> Ultimate Energy per second while she is out of combat.

ShortDescription.SourceString:
释放极轨终结第一段，对目标范围内的敌人造成高额<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>，并进入<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">「华彩连段」</>状态，期间明音凛的抗打断能力提升。
状态持续4秒后，可随时再次点按极轨终结释放第二段并提前结束<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">「华彩连段」</>状态，再次对目标范围内的敌人造成高额<Xiang>相属性异能伤害</>。第二段需手动释放，不会在状态结束时自动触发。状态结束时仍未释放，第二段将失效。
该状态不会移除或替代当前生效的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">「泛音列」</>或<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">「音域」</>效果。
ShortDescription.LocalizedString:
Casts the first instance of Sonic Boom, dealing massive <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to enemies within the target area and entering <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">Solo Cadenza</>. Increases her Resistance to Interruptions while the state is active.
Allows the second instance to be cast by pressing Sonic Boom again at any time after Solo Cadenza has been active for 4s, ending <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneCadenza">Solo Cadenza</> early, dealing massive <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to enemies within the target area. Requires the second instance to be cast manually. Does not automatically cast the second instance when Solo Cadenza ends. The second instance becomes unavailable if not cast before Solo Cadenza ends.
Solo Cadenza functions independently of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneHarmonicMark">Overtone</> and <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AkaneSoundField">Reverb Field</> and does not remove or replace either effect.

Description.SourceString: <Italic>「这才是真正的音乐啊！」台下的粉丝泪流满面地如是说道。</>
Description.LocalizedString: <Italic>"Now that's what I call music!" a fan in the crowd exclaimed, tears streaming down their face.</>
